The Trump Court has willfully created a health crisis. **This recent article paints a horrifying picture of the reality millions of women face.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90913128/492096027/-2122444374?refcode=2024-08-15-choice&recurring=&amount=17&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=54024d1e-665b-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NDAyNGQxZS02NjViLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NTcKfhCCE8qTLBR8KA1n_CdQL1F98qTtzT655g8tNRk=) Here's a graphic snippet from the article: WASHINGTON (AP) — Bleeding and in pain, Kyleigh Thurman didn't know her doomed pregnancy could kill her. Emergency room doctors at Ascension Seton Williamson in Texas handed her a pamphlet on miscarriage and told her to "let nature take its course" before discharging her without treatment for her ectopic pregnancy. When the 25-year-old returned three days later, still bleeding, doctors finally agreed to give her an injection to end the pregnancy. It was too late. The fertilized egg growing on Thurman's fallopian tube ruptured it, destroying part of her reproductive system. **"I was left to flail," Thurman said. "It was nothing short of being misled."** The last thing we need in the exam room when making personal, intimate decisions about our bodies is judgmental politicians who want to dictate the outcome regardless of the health risks. **Right now, we are failing millions of women.** We are seeing in real time the very real consequences of taking away the right to safe and legal abortions. Across the country, MAGA Republicans have passed laws banning abortion, criminalizing providers, and restricting access to contraception. More than 1 in 3 women in America currently live under some form of abortion ban. Women are waiting longer for life-saving care, being turned away from emergency rooms, and, in some cases, being forced to figure out how they can afford to travel hundreds of miles to get the reproductive care they need. **In Oregon, we've made it clear we will stand strong for the right to compassionate reproductive care.** That's how it should be. The decision to have an abortion is one that should be made by you and only you – not by judges, not by MAGA politicians, and not by your ability to pay or the zip code you live in. **No matter where a woman lives in this country, she should have the right to access the full range of reproductive care.** That's why I'm focused on holding the Senate Democratic Majority and retaking the House in 2024 so we can enshrine abortion rights into federal law. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1784%2E135344%2Ex7SBTj)

A few weeks ago, Joe Biden made the patriotic decision to put our democracy first and suspend his presidential campaign.
One thing is clear: Michigan is more important than ever to winning the White House this November. Our ever-so swingy swing state was the tipping point in 2016, the tipping point in 2020, and will likely be the deciding factor once again this November.
It’s no secret that this is a historic moment in our nation’s history and an inflection point in our race: Because the Senate race is the top of the ticket, our performance likely impacts the presidential and vice versa.
But I’ve won three tough elections, so I’m no stranger to responding to big moments in a campaign. In 2020, Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg passed away in September. In 2022, the Supreme Court struck down _Roe v. Wade_.
Both of these moments -- and the one we’re in now — had the potential to shift the future of our country. Our campaign will have to adapt, but that’s what we’re good at.
But we know that this news is also firing up the Republican base. And we need to not only match that enthusiasm but EXCEED it.
We have built a campaign that can win in November, but only with your continued support.
[**So, if holding the Senate and the White House is worth $3 to you, that is the donation we're asking you to make directly to my campaign.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240722-1-900&t=2&akid=1784%2E135344%2Ex7SBTj)

Now, we’re seeing a surge of grassroots momentum from Democrats across the country — I'm so excited to watch this excitement grow even more with the Democratic National Convention next week. The national momentum is drumming up just as I head into my primary here in Florida, which is just 5 days away. My team and I are doing everything we can, from traveling across the state to connect with voters, launching Spanish radio ads to fight back against Rick Scott's attack ads naming me directly during the _Copa América_ broadcast, to filming brand-new TV ads.

**Make no mistake: Mitch McConnell's time as Senate GOP leader was one of the worst things to ever happen to the Senate.** It will take years for our country and our democracy to fully recover from his decades of corruption, cronyism, extremism, and obstruction.
_**But Rick Scott as Senate GOP leader would be much, much worse.**_
He's already spent over** $4 MILLION **running attack ads, and he can keep writing checks from his massive fortune of almost a quarter-billion dollars. Last time around, he spent **$64 million **of his own fortune to buy his seat.

Friend — We are less than 4 hours from our August mid-month fundraising deadline.

[**Before I explain why this deadline is so important, will you chip in a split donation of $10 between my campaign and Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48596?t=7&akid=21879%2E4449941%2EIHaUk4) | [DONATE »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48596?t=8&akid=21879%2E4449941%2EIHaUk4)

August is just 3 months from November, which means that **we don’t have time to fall behind** on our fundraising goals.

Hitting each fundraising goal, or _falling short_ , will produce one of two possible narratives — that grassroots Democrats are doing everything possible to defeat Republicans this November, or if _we’re leaving the door cracked open for a GOP wave this November._

I’m going to be honest with you — we are a bit behind on our goal this month.

But I’m not worried because I know I can rely on this team to always show up. From the beginning of my campaign, I’ve counted on our team to fuel our efforts to fight against the extreme MAGA agenda and build the biggest grassroots movement California has ever seen.

This team has gotten me this far, and I know they can carry me through the election.
[**With all of this being said, will you rush a split donation today between Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats, and my campaign to get us back on track to reach our August mid-month fundraising goal?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48596?t=9&akid=21879%2E4449941%2EIHaUk4)

We can’t give the GOP any leverage to say that this campaign is weak or losing momentum. With your help, we won’t.

— Adam

Fellow Conservative,

I’m writing to ensure you’ve seen the latest public polling, released last Thursday, showing my Montana U.S. Senate race virtually tied. While I’m “leading” by two points, our lead is within the margin of error.

[ ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=233e0f3221e242df91c7edabd0e984d6&_e=gQQj2rH994AMakmAHvvbfs9K_wmy_P8XnhuxAxBeEVhBrxRt13KiyIHuAveV3qL9DSNvMk_UtNXzQ-uTSnySp7qXxk2ngbrPNG1zc7GXzqLwsCu5f4YspXYMStn-pU5OxEoxUEWNwd6u6m0qCXT8wmgJvLYmZ3fYTdlkoKO_dU9oMRYf6FAkTXi8Fm11aP4Urdv3_Qanz3LJiJzj40W4CluKtHWOS7F8D-UgZvVoI6LpoMW-UhEAqQLUA54li_B--jCv2a2qQn8806ixgPgc-pU9zaWn6F-qh-sC3GzHwYKyXwhoRf4EpSv1cQG2f1tPEKNWI3DyCQPkls1t9the-qk2eRdRSXJ0PJcHgivF9wu5Il6jtnvHzYUXfeQrc8RIb2gP6dpZvyZnWLqXbuqFzff1kt0t3iIMTSvRHCPlwsc%3D)
**If the polling is correct, we could be leading by two points, tied with Jon Tester, or even running two points behind.** What’s more, the field of voters who will determine the outcome of this race is only getting smaller by the day.

**Last fall, the share of undecided voters stood at 15%. # Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I Zoomed with the Senior/Retiree Caucus of the Iowa Democratic Party, spoke at a candidate forum in Nevada, gave a speech at the famous Wing Ding annual gathering in Clear Lake, learned a lot about what ails Iowa at the CCI Convention in Ankeny, and spoke at the Soapbox at the Iowa State Fair (my opponent neither attended the Nevada candidate forum he was invited to nor spoke at the Soapbox).
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: The big story has been (per the link below) the unacceptable posting of threats on the doors of Hispanic-run establishments against the immigrant community in Hampton in Franklin County, which is in my district. There are a number of towns in my district that have been rejuvenated by immigrants, and we've needed that injection of new life considering just about all of our 36 counties have seen steady population decline for decades. These folks are great people, despite the untrue, inciteful rhetoric many Iowa and national-level politicians use against them. I've long thought that we should happily welcome in parents who are willing to walk thousands of miles to escape violence to give their kids a better life. Someone with that kind of fortitude is not a threat, they are someone that would and have made our communities better. Despite the misinformation used to malign migrants in the Latino community, so many data points show they commit crime at much lower rates than native-born citizens.
For sure, there is much to fix regarding our immigration system. I'd personally advocate for a robust immigrant labor program that aligns migration flows with labor need. In other words, we need better federal-state coordination on the issue so municipalities with labor shortages can be prioritized for immigrant placement while, for example, immigrants are awaiting their asylum hearing. There'd need to be better coordination on housing and resource availability, to not strain the social safety net of cities that may not be able to absorb more folks, but it's clear that in a state like ours where the state legislature rolled back decades of child labor law, we need more workers and more energy injected into our communities.
The Latino community in Hampton is already living on heightened alert considering the vilification it receives from candidates and elected officials. Our thoughts are with them in the face of this unacceptable attack on their comfort and confidence. We value them as positive contributors to our communities, and as good, loving parents to their kiddos.

Our schedule for this week: On Monday, 8/12, I attended an anti-carbon capture pipeline rally in Alden put on by a variety of different left and right-leaning groups that share common cause over our opposition to the pipelines. On Tuesday, 8/13, I attended a post card writing party in Marshalltown (if you're interested in writing for us, let me know!). On Wednesday, 8/14, I started conversations on putting together a radio ad. Today, Thursday, 8/15, I attended and spoke at the Humboldt County Dems Dinner in Humboldt (It was a great turn out!) Saturday, 8/17, I'll have events at the Sibley public library from 1030 - noon and at a private house event at 2 in Monona County. Sunday 8/18, I'll be door knocking with my friends, state house candidate Penny Vossler and state senate candidate Margaret Liston in Boone County.
Recent press/social media posts of note: https://www.kcci.com/article/hate-crime-racist-flyers-show-up-outside-latino-owned-businesses-in-hampton/61879644
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton

Our Republican Party needs these America First Fighters in the US Senate to work with President Trump to rebuild our country after Joe Biden’s destructive term. |
Fellow American,

We are fortunate to have battle-tested conservative leaders running for United States Senate. These brave men have served in combat as members of America's armed forces that secure our nation from foreign threats.

We owe them a debt of gratitude for their service and sacrifice. We can never repay that debt, but we can stand with these brave men as they work to flip four seats and elect a Republican Senate Majority.

We have NO TIME TO LOSE PASSING THE AMERICA FIRST AGENDA.

**Sam Brown, Tim Sheehy, Hung Cao, and Dave McCormick are American heroes we can count on to stay true to their word and FIGHT for conservative principles and our shared Republican values in the Senate. **

[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=be9bf727e60941a0bb3d861db6ddfecb&_e=hjgrRGIdMPx9sukErqHwlB4I_lI775wdQvaVuZ3a97WwLTk_-LvxsFTYgxh1i84tSd3QeBgC8EX-yGQZUhu51tfQO1c_o_5h5Ff10rBK612X0kXwFbDszKAT9Z7RE8f6FG-LJASoowLLebBAdviLgHR8ND2p2c8fAwksrxN1ILDh1CifSbHlVhM9vxrOGAeSOWcyuj_WdXLQLmX2FenmHrpRaiwU8vekHo4MoiPZCU2kki3Y3R-MHMnq2PhjdE_nT8HXy2rpaxRbdYYzqW2Sjp4usw6mJry-wxx2MSTrIG13mPsFzKJpUBVbuFdsY0GY0xxFwPsIdXbcfJRThaqqojn4Cvv1GMeLXV-BG3tM6lm1sCk4jIy8-iPrMTzHzpdrIVAA0aELSlo7sa0OCQW_JxvKRRTfHZQZceBOTvpV0nO2vj46JgOjf1GCC23iynuCP1p5exqOzxdLa_uKhUqBcvrflsuV6oDd7HnC-lUp5bg%3D)

clean_body: | | | ** Friend, As the 2024 election looms, we stand at a crossroads, one where the soul of our nation hangs in the balance. We must unite behind one single issue -defeating Trump to save our democracy. It's the bedrock on which all our other cherished issues rest. Trump, with his authoritarian leanings, seeks to re-open the scars he inflicted on our country and the very foundations of our democracy. His re-election would again traumatize the nation with division and discord and steer us toward isolation and despotism. Kamala Harris and Tim Walz have emerged as beacons of hope, championing a future where democracy isn't just preserved but revitalized. Their joyful campaign is a clarion call to restore the democratic ethos that champions inclusivity, unity, and progress. The Harris/Walz ticket reminds us that saving our democracy is not merely a political necessity; it is the foundation upon which all our cherished issues—healthcare, climate, justice—can thrive. **** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. Every day there is a story in the news about voter fraud. Most of them are from the leftists in the media telling you voter fraud doesn't exist. But they are lying to you.

Not only does it exist, but it is a very real threat to the future of our republic.

# Senate Democrats are Fighting Climate Change
---
|
---
Defending the Senate is crucial because Democrats are leading significant efforts to combat climate change, a pressing issue impacting every state, industry, and American. Senators like Tammy Baldwin, who is up for re-election and serves on the climate change committee, have been instrumental in driving progress. Over the last four years, this committee has become one of the most effective in history, pushing for ambitious actions to address the climate crisis. Every state in the union is feeling the effects of climate change, and it is clear that every industry and business is affected. Republicans in the Senate have been slow to accept, let alone propose, real solutions. That’s why the work of this Special Committee in the Senate is essential.
---
|
---
You can make a real difference in defending the Senate this November with No Dem Left Behind. One donation goes to 4 different battleground fights in the Senate, and it can go a long way towards fighting climate change. Their work focuses on understanding how inaction on climate change harms the U.S.'s economic and national security interests and how taking action presents significant opportunities for job creation, public health, and the economy. By keeping the Senate blue, we can continue this vital progress and work towards a sustainable future. Let's ensure we maintain this momentum by supporting leaders like Tammy Baldwin and other Senate Democrats committed to addressing climate change.

## Harris County Revives Controversial Program
Harris County officials voted Thursday to relaunch a [guaranteed income program](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O2zAQhJ-G6mhQe5RMFyzSsLu0KY01uZKI8EcgV7rz2wcKkDLdADMYzHy_Pp-fGFMs60_MZPl7qU_0HE96GjnOEvRTD8G-VHiMA9nxDh9mVOYxD5tFmsl7FaZAxsNCC2ky08vTOGFAdR-iBQVamXEe1TSDuWkDrwcsaprvGBbUQisKkWu78UZM39iX9K4ntZuveUh2Y967-PghwAlwvuZ8lMjvmHf0fGUEuK0enWu5FMV14y5bPKnJir-7zLVwq50EuPXqLZkKC3DXLgFOGQFunAS4Ql_pLRudmHcK8thTXFhu2FrsEpTcW10bZslVJjyK32Qs_2xfj8JvAW5oNuxfMaXY57vQas0Y098r_B-yp4U_AQAA__8GyX-F) with added restrictions after Attorney General Ken Paxton challenged its legality, citing the Texas Constitution's ban on giving public funds to individuals. The initial program would have provided $500 monthly payments to 1,900 participants for 18 months, but it was put on hold when the Texas Supreme Court [expressed doubts](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGvpCAURn8Ndhi4gmJBsY3dbLulucJFyaJMkBln_v3Lm_Ilr_zyFSfn_LvNN4wpHutf3MnWV8gzuhqfNBsuew5qVo23i_CjbMjKATojhRn7ZrOuE4sCI4LRPshRumUAEJ1ENWrR6aWJFgQoYWQvhe7BtMrAMkIQuh_QB1RMCfKx5tLWjSq98AzpnZ9UWpf3Jtmt1vvJuj8MJgbTdV3t_y0_vk8GE5YaXSIG00HXyWBK2WFiMG1YSjy5y4-jvn9u_sHw9YEFj0rkeTxc3onfS14L7jzFA_kWPaY1M5jAaE7KY6-94J7GwJUeFDfSjNzJgRZyoIVxTbH-fsWU4tkPTIl1x5g-GvWXqk8LXwEAAP__x3l5aA) about its constitutionality. The revamped initiative, dubbed Uplift Harris 2.0, has been modified to provide pre-loaded cards with spending restrictions. The Commissioners Court approved the new program 4-1, with Republican Commissioner [Tom Ramsey opposing](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGvpCAUhX8NdkzgiqgFxWQTi03eFttsae7AVUkQDOA48-838_pXnZOcU3z5_n3NX-iDj-sf3MnU15JmtNU_aR641BzUrBpnHsKNsiEje2gHKYZRN5txj1aAFY46LRbd6Vai7HpQ1g6kRxwbb0CAEoPUUnQahpsa4DHCIjrdo1tQMSXI-ZryrW5U6YVlCe_0pHyzaW-C2Wo9CmvvDCYG03Vdt73Ez8ZgosjPwmCKdH3iu2-Ysy_cpjPWN_eFBzyj3XxcOfI9Ob94cnw9MWOsRI77aNNO_MhpzbjzJYWQrs_9wFdNsfBAKwZuNwyB4koMJsz8fpfp7_vX7yYbd1w-BF90z5RYd_ThG73-YPJp4H8AAAD__3Y2eVE), arguing that the $20.5 million in federal pandemic relief funds could be better spent elsewhere.
## Surfside Beach Down to One Cop After Mass Exodus
The Surfside Beach Police Department has [experienced a mass resignation](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1v8yAYAH8NbFjwGPMxMLxLtrxrRwvDQ4KKTWRoSP991ezd73TSfVzXq88lH7f_fkfXX6muPvT8xNUwoRjIVdLoNh6toOiEhtkIbqyid2eVUWLhIshZ60UqnCFwZbdlszIYHmh2wEFyI5TgiwIzSQObhcQXpX1MXhLJMeZez6nfsePLt1S-6xPPKdSdFnfv_dHI_I_AhcBljDEdONpA_PwFCFzeDut1HKxg6qweyGpKOeDJfOp4skctOSDbfWsMXzV-NSbsbI3Q9HTxMXIpuSlNJL_tPpd3uP_x4engJwAA__89DWBF), leaving only one active officer for the town of 640. The exodus began on Monday when the [police chief and three officers resigned](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLtuhDAQAL_GdEbrxRhTuEhDd2lTorW9HFbMQ-A7Ln8fXfrUo5FG83Ubb5RyWu-ftLArr2kbKZT05NFKZSTqUVfReYi9qtipDhurwPammp0C5cF2gGxsiyH4QLYzweouBDB-qpJDQA1WGQWtQVtri77HCVrTUZxICw0cU9mOusxc-EXnlH-2Jx912JYqu7mU_RTNh8BB4HBdV_09b483FDjQUVLILHBY-ToFDnkLlAUO5-OYzhRZeqYwy33LKbCMvNNRFl6LPPhM9_WtoG2lbpi0Mkaa4FupbUOSQBkZfUNeNdCqqa8OF_cr5ZxO0wkN94VS_oss_zx7OvwNAAD__-0HbKc), followed by four more resignations on Wednesday. The sole remaining officer, Kelly Marsh, has been promoted to interim police chief. ## Venomous "Fireworms" Invade Texas Beaches

---
Big polling news out of Ohio! **Bernie Moreno** has pulled to within **_4 points_** of liberal Senator **Sherrod Brown** in what may be the closest Senate race of 2024. There are two huge data points in this poll, which shows Brown with 46% and Moreno with 42%. _First_ , it shows Moreno has cut Brown’s lead _in half_ since May. _Second_ , this is the first poll of the cycle with Brown _under 50%_! This is a HUGE problem for incumbent candidates who are universally known in their states. It’s a signal that Ohio voters _do not support_ Sherrod Brown and are looking for new leadership. This would be a major story even if this race were a fair fight. But it’s not. As a lifelong politician and chairman of the Senate Banking Committee, Sherrod Brown’s campaign is cashing checks from special interests left and right. He has spent _**FOUR TIMES AS MUCH**_ as Moreno. Yet despite a hurricane of false attacks from Sherrod Brown and the press, Moreno has closed the Ohio Senate race to a statistical dead heat. _Why?_ **Because his message is finally breaking through.**
---
---
Ohio is a red state, and Sherrod Brown is as blue as any Democrat in Washington. Unlike Brown, Moreno actually represents the people and the values of the Buckeye State. **Bernie Moreno is a principled conservative who will fight for border security, a strong economy, school choice, American energy, a strong military, medical freedom, and election integrity!!** But this means he will face the worst from the radical Left. | One of our amazing constituents in Hanover County needs our help. She is a home school mother whom I first met in 2023, Elisabeth Foley. Elisabeth fought off a viscous bull shark attack while on a Florida vacation in June with her husband and three children. She was bitten in both of her upper legs, her buttocks, and the attack severed her left hand. Through prayer, surgeries, and determination she is still with us. I sat down with Elisabeth, her husband Ryan, and mother in law Judy at their home to pray and discuss the challenges ahead that include more surgeries. | Nearly 80 years after his death, U.S. Army Sgt. Mayburn Hudson was laid to rest in his hometown of Lynchburg, VA last Wednesday, August 7th. clean_body: | | | | == | == | Early Voting Starts September 20 | | Friends, We are staying busy on the campaign trail. There is so much at stake this election. Please remind folks early voting begins 20 September and Election Day is 5 November. Here is some of what we have been up to: | Elisabeth Foley, Hanover, Survives Shark Attack | | | | We first met Feb 2023. | One of our amazing constituents in Hanover County needs our help. She is a home school mother whom I first met in 2023, Elisabeth Foley. Elisabeth fought off a viscous bull shark attack while on a Florida vacation in June with her husband and three children. She was bitten in both of her upper legs, her buttocks, and the attack severed her left hand. Through prayer, surgeries, and determination she is still with us. I sat down with Elisabeth, her husband Ryan, and mother in law Judy at their home to pray and discuss the challenges ahead that include more surgeries. She said she prayed to God to save her during the attack. Elisabeth may have lost her left hand, but she has not lost her faith in our Lord and her positive outlook on life. They're coming back
In the spring, Iranian-funded, radical, left-wing college students from America’s best universities seized control of their campuses.
| [ ](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=1645208c652948f7b74147373ca65158&_e=QA8cz9VC5JgiwT8tG8itB19D71z3YklOcCIVhC7vRaXQDG3MfP_f0toEUbsb-4g54HuddNTZBU_rX31nbl5BLyfGEuMIs-A0RuHmyvb3pQ_36tbXSqYjXKINCrlhGY35BxTKHkmcgqMqToNCY7USy-splUv3ObClUj_HqG7zQoJ_iWR66aAbrufDu5ijm7FumI8K5DJ8uiQiSUtw1Z1tPv9yuc6anKCh0IM_VhbmC9OE_MS07ecjII-J_7EgJe8gYrh7O87YWOLRigVT22yEGM7rsuHuIxZrxH4MzDffLi2rIGL0-r3b_UBbk1F7vFLYjFsZb2Tap8HUQf_AxZkxBgeB_w7dJnbxjYaFwRnkCCFtJA5zpoo1z8G4wyzGk78g)

Peter, In the spring, Iranian-funded, radical, left-wing college students from America’s best universities seized control of their campuses.

They destroyed property.

They physically intimidated Jewish students (once driving many to hide inside a library!). And, through it all, they chanted hateful calls for genocide. But, did anyone oppose them on campus?

Administrations largely cowered. And, at the start, the mainstream media largely ignored them. However, a few The Fund for American Studies (TFAS) student journalists said no. At Harvard, Stanford, Northwestern, the University of Chicago, and more, our students said no.

Student journalists, such as those at the _Harvard Salient_ , published op-eds denouncing their peers.

"There is no excuse for a Harvard Student--or any American--choosing to carry water for these groups." \- The Harvard Salient

[Peter will you make the first donation to our campaign by donating $500, $250, $100, $50, or even just $25 right now?](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=1645208c652948f7b74147373ca65158&_e=QA8cz9VC5JgiwT8tG8itB19D71z3YklOcCIVhC7vRaXQDG3MfP_f0toEUbsb-4g54HuddNTZBU_rX31nbl5BLyfGEuMIs-A0RuHmyvb3pQ_36tbXSqYjXKINCrlhGY35BxTKHkmcgqMqToNCY7USy-splUv3ObClUj_HqG7zQoJ_iWR66aAbrufDu5ijm7FumI8K5DJ8uiQiSUtw1Z1tPpnKFIw178pPA2UcAen51kU1NhUOwDjUp7aFgb0z_EdpWM1QCnkq0GoYQgfXd1f4WPrGeKx9-fKk-bE_RDpkLkNxbLoDAqoXnHduvExOuKcdo1KKMPb1ixZGkzDvMHcLGktdQb6JjTD1oOPFiaAznugIvBEBSDhgIX_RqAZFOWYP)

# Cain for Us Campaign Update
---
| Friends -
The September 3rd Primary is fast approaching, and I continue to travel the state to meet directly with voters. From small coffees, to Zoom meet and greets, to Republican Town Committees across the Commonwealth, it has been an honor to get to know so many voters ready for change.
I’ve also had the opportunity to debate my fellow candidates multiple times, and each conversation has made it clear we need a **real** conservative, a **real** Bay Stater, and candidate with a **real** chance to win. I know I am that candidate for Massachusetts and I hope I can count on your support.
Thank you,Ian Cain

We are witnessing a profound and alarming shift in global governance—a shift that threatens the very foundation of freedom and democracy. Today’s authoritarianism knows no boundaries, and its reach is expanding at an unprecedented pace.

Such actions are not isolated incidents; they are part of a broader agenda by elites who seek to control what we can read, see, and hear.
They justify this censorship by labeling dissenting voices as “misinformation,” “hate speech,” “far-right,” or “extremist.” **These labels are wielded as weapons to silence opposition and stifle free expression.**
Throughout history, totalitarian regimes have begun their reigns of terror with censorship. The suppression of free speech has often been the precursor to greater atrocities. It starts with silencing dissent, manipulating information, and instilling fear in those who dared to speak the truth.
[This pattern is disturbingly familiar, and we must recognize it for what it is: a prelude to oppression.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=warning_to_america_8_15_rsnd1&n=4)

During the COVID-19 lockdowns, MI-6 labeled health freedom activists, including myself, as potential “terrorists.” Yet, it is the authorities who employ fear as a tool of control, perpetuating narratives of pandemics, economic collapse, and endless wars to maintain their grip on power.
These tactics are designed to frighten us into compliance, but we must not yield.
[This is a wake-up call for America and the world. We must reclaim our right to free speech and resist the creeping tide of authoritarianism. If not in America, the paragon of freedom, then where? ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=warning_to_america_8_15_rsnd1&n=6)
We owe it to ourselves, to future generations, and to the countless voices silenced by oppressive regimes throughout history. That’s why we’re asking for your urgent support right now.
Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is our best hope for ending this insidious censorship and restoring our fundamental rights.
With less than 90 days before the election, we’ve set ambitious monthly goals to continue our historic campaign.

name: Mayra Flores
subject: Conceded my election.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Service and Honor
body:
This is probably the hardest email I’ve ever written.

| |
---
| | | | | | | | Friend \--
I wish things would have gone a different way... | **_Democrat Vicente Gonzalez holds back Republican surge, returns 34th Congressional District to Democratic control._**
---

This is probably the hardest email I've ever written.

**I 'm Mayra Flores, the America First Hispanic woman running in the biggest race in the nation.**

After we made history and flipped a blue seat red for the first time in 100 years, the Democrats threw the kitchen sink at me, **and I had to concede my race. **

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/niHTS8sUXmg8tT7NPBO5zg~~/AARclAA~~)

---
Everyone expected me to just walk away - _but I 'm not someone who ever, ever gives up._

I'm taking a leap of faith here and have thrown my name on the ballot once again.

The Democrats know that if they lose the Hispanic vote, it's over for them. _Forever._

Friend, I just got a text from my campaign manager, and listen, it's not good news: **We fell just short of our $1 million mid-month fundraising goal yesterday. **

Student journalists, such as those at the _Harvard Salient_ , published op-eds denouncing their peers.

Please let me explain how we’ve built the boldest grassroots movement in Missouri history
#
Hey Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
I want to take some time today to tell you a little more about the campaign we’re building to defeat Josh Hawley here in Missouri — and why it’s already the boldest grassroots movement our state has ever seen.
**Will you please let me explain?**

For decades, lying politicians have let massive corporations strip our communities for parts — and Missouri has had a front row seat.
I can’t accept a status quo where politicians who take massive donations from Big Ag tell us it’s normal for billionaires in China and Brazil to buy up our farmland and put hard-working family farmers out of business. I refuse to stand by and watch members of Congress who’ve never worn a uniform sacrifice American lives and tax dollars on forever wars, while refusing to invest into the everyday people who make our country strong.
Out-of-touch elites like Josh Hawley have spent decades wasting our money on tax breaks and subsidies for Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and just about everything else that’s gutting our country.
They’re willing to lie, cheat, and steal from the American people to protect the corporate PACs and mega-donors who own their careers. And they’ll even raise their fist to look strong before they start running from threats to our democracy.
**We don’t need any more frauds in Congress.** That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. It’s why I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs. [**And it’s why today, I’m asking you to make your first donation of $10 or whatever you think is best toward my campaign today. Can I count on you to help us stay on track to hit our August fundraising goal, defeat Josh Hawley, and take this seat back for working people?**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66894?refcode=em20240816-7359&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7359%2E614464%2EY5tiBb)

Our mission of taking power back for everyday people has earned our movement national media attention. And our commitment to running this campaign the right way, without a cent from corporate PACs, has given us the ability to run the boldest campaign in Missouri history — taking on corrupt political elites like Hawley without hesitation about some mega-donor being upset.
More than just fighting to codify protections for abortion access — **I’m running to end the filibuster so we can actually get it done.**
More than just banning insider trading among members of Congress and their families — **I’m running to put them in jail if they steal from us.**
More than just breaking up Big Pharma — **I’m running to prosecute the insulin cartels who are killing people.**
And more than just rejecting corporate PAC money — **I’m running to abolish corporate PACs altogether.**
**This campaign is powered by the people because that’s exactly who I’ll work for in the U.S. Senate** — I'll be accountable to real, everyday Americans, not some corporate executive or political machine. We’re throwing out their rulebook and building a grassroots movement to fundamentally change who has power in our country. **And I want you to join our team:**
[**So if you’re ready to help us take back power for everyday people in Missouri and across the country, please add a donation of $10 or whatever you can toward my campaign today.**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66894?refcode=em20240816-7359&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=7359%2E614464%2EY5tiBb)

For too long, our country’s corrupt politicians have bought their way into power and maintained a broken status quo. That cycle ends with our movement.
Thanks for being part of it,
Lucas Kunce

Derek,
Last month during the Republican National Convention, I reached out asking you to join me in calling on President Biden to submit his nominees for the United States Postal Service Board of Governors. That’s the first step in removing Louis DeJoy from his position as Postmaster General.
**Derek, Biden has now submitted his nominees to the Senate. Including my good friend and former colleague Val Demings from Florida.**
**[Now, we need to call on the United States Senate to take up these nominations with haste. Until then, Louis DeJoy can continue to wreak havoc on the Postal Service, causing more mail delays, price increases, and issues _right before the election_. Add your name and join me in putting pressure on the Senate today.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240816-dejoy-petition.lM32me&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240816_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=7248%2E5257348%2EJim6Ee)**
[STOP DEJOY](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240816-dejoy-petition.lM32me&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240816_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=7248%2E5257348%2EJim6Ee)
---
I’ve long called for President Biden to submit his nominees for the USPS Board of Governors to the Senate so they can confirm members to fill the two vacant seats and finally vote to remove Louis DeJoy — and I’m glad that he has finally done so.
As the finance chair of the Republican National Committee, DeJoy raised and contributed millions to GOP candidates.
He was investigated by the FBI for an alleged straw donor scheme with his employees, where he would award bonuses as kickbacks for political contributions.
He slowed down the mail during the 2020 election, at the height of the pandemic, and has repeatedly raised prices while providing worse service.
He even attempted to purchase 90% gasoline-powered vehicles for the Postal Service fleet instead of moving to a greener fleet, until we passed legislation and he finally gave in.
**Derek, millions of Americans who rely on the Postal Service deserve better. It’s time for DeJoy to go.**
**[Now that President Biden has submitted his nominees for the USPS Board of Governors to the Senate, we need to call on the Senate to confirm these appointments. Quickly. Add your name to show your support.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240816-dejoy-petition.lM32me&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240816_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=7248%2E5257348%2EJim6Ee)**
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240816-dejoy-petition.lM32me&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240816_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=7&akid=7248%2E5257348%2EJim6Ee)
---
There is no excuse for allowing this hyperpartisan, potentially corrupt Postmaster General to lead the Postal Service during a presidential election in which the nominee of his party, Donald Trump, who gave him the job and incited a violent insurrection after he lost, is running.
So please, take a moment today to join me and raise your voice. This is important.
Thanks,
Adam

body:
I’m personally counting on you
| Peter, I’m Riley Gaines. Maybe you’ve heard me talk about how other female swimmers and I were forced to compete against men -- and even share locker rooms with them.
Most people sat idly by and allowed this injustice to happen. That’s when I realized that nobody else was going to stand up for me, my teammates, and other women like us. I had to speak out. When I took the stage for my acceptance speech -- to represent California in the Senate -- I tore up my notes. I just said, **“We will fight.”** Then I went home and I sat on the couch with a family-sized bag of nacho Doritos. I did not share one chip with anybody. _Not even Doug._ I just watched the TV with utter shock and dismay. Two things are true eight years later: _I still love Doritos and we still have not stopped fighting._ Here’s the deal, Peter: We can’t go back. We can’t go back to the way we all felt on that harrowing day in 2016 when Donald Trump was elected. Friend,

Yet _another poll_ is out on the New Mexico Senate race that shows us **closing in on Martin Heinrich.**

Here’s what the latest poll shows:
* We’re only six points down
* Heinrich polling his lowest ever at only 40%
* 21% of voters are undecided!

Remember, this is a seat that the mainstream media is telling us was _supposed_ to be safe blue, and the Democrats NEVER thought would be in danger.

It is telling that a career politician like Heinrich— _who has been in the Senate for over a decade_ —has 60% of voters in his “safe blue” state not ready or willing to vote for him!

This is a clear sign that voters in New Mexico are **fed up** with the radical and destructive agenda he and the Biden-Harris regime have been pushing on us.

_**It’s no wonder we outraised Heinrich last quarter and continue to close in on him!**_

#
Folks — Normally on the campaign trail, politicians talk about legislation they recently passed — not laws from the 1800s. But the _Comstock Act_ is coming up often, so I wanted to take a moment to explain this law — and why I’m trying to repeal it. The _Comstock Act_ is a 150-year-old absurd, outdated piece of legislation that has not been broadly enforced for nearly a century. **But Trump, Vance, and their MAGA policy advisors are planning to use this legislation to ban abortion nationwide.** By outlawing the mailing of abortion medications like mifepristone, as well as the medical equipment doctors need to perform abortions, a new Trump administration could try to make legal abortions nearly impossible. Enforcing the _Comstock Act_ would make it significantly harder for women to access reproductive care — even in states where abortion is legally protected. I’m in it for folks like you, because I know you deserve someone who’ll stand tall for you in Washington. Hello,
After the 2022 election, my husband Adam Frisch and I went to Washington for “freshman orientation” for new members of Congress.
We still didn’t know whether or not Adam had defeated Lauren Boebert. We were in the middle of a recount – and Adam was down by only a few hundred votes.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90947402/492202089/1610638071?refcode=em20240816mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=1e49fc9b-e85b-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZTQ5ZmM5Yi1lODViLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4oGuQ3j_ExIUxKNr-MPlBSiSdgrTmVSM2JdpURQmPZE=)

Now, Adam’s running again in 2024 – and with Lauren Boebert now out of the race, I know he can win this time. But first, we have to fix the reason he so narrowly lost in 2022.
**During the last campaign, we got out-spent – by millions and millions of dollars.** It wasn’t that we didn’t put in the work (we did). It wasn’t that Adam didn’t have a positive vision for the district (he does). We were just drowned out in millions of dollars of lie-filled attack ads.
**If Adam’s going to be able to finish the job and win this critical House seat, we cannot afford to get out-spent again – and we’re counting on your help now.**
**We’ve set a goal to raise another $35,000 before our fundraising deadline at midnight tonight, but right now, we still have $6,720 left to raise.**

We were in the middle of a recount – and Adam was down by only a few hundred votes. = Ultimately, though, after all the votes were counted, Adam came up short. We lost to Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. Now, Adam’s running again in 2024 – and with Lauren Boebert now out of the race, I know he can win this time. But first, we have to fix the reason he so narrowly lost in 2022. During the last campaign, we got out-spent – by millions and millions of dollars. It wasn’t that we didn’t put in the work (we did). It wasn’t that Adam didn’t have a positive vision for the district (he does). We were just drowned out in millions of dollars of lie-filled attack ads. If Adam’s going to be able to finish the job and win this critical House seat, we cannot afford to get out-spent again – and we’re counting on your help now. We’ve set a goal to raise another $35,000 before our fundraising deadline at midnight tonight, but right now, we still have $6,720 left to raise. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I’ll admit, the first campaign was hard – for the whole family. But we’re all-in win this November. Thank you for being on this journey with us, Katy ** Paid for by Adam for Colorado. Tim Sheehy

body:
https://www.edwardsforhouston.com/ [https://www.edwardsforhouston.com/]
Hi Peter,
From the start, our mission was to amplify the concerns of the people and provide solutions. This is the people’s seat, and it is the people’s needs – for a healthier community, a more resilient community, and true economic opportunity – that must guide us as we move forward.
With the needs of the people in mind, I have decided not to enter the special election called by Governor Abbott to serve the remainder of the current Congressional term. If there is a runoff for this seat, the timing would require the runoff to take place after the term expired, which would leave the seat vacant. Because of the high likelihood of a runoff in the special election if more candidates join this race, we could see an outcome where the seat remains unfilled through the end of the term, leaving the important business of this district unaddressed. The well-being of our community is too important for the seat to continue to go unrepresented, so I have chosen to put the community’s interests before my desire to serve.
To the supporters who poured their energy into this campaign—your passion and dedication are nothing short of inspiring. Please remember, this is just one chapter in a much longer story. Change is never easy. It requires effort, consistency, and a willingness to persevere. But every step we have taken together is a crucial step toward the betterment of this community. I am excited to keep building on what we’ve started so that the community can get the results that it deserves.
I am so grateful to each and every one of you.
Thank you!
Amanda K. Edwards

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: Kamala Harris & Tim Walz
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
It’s been an exciting time since Vice President Kamala Harris announced her running mate, Minnesota Governor Tim Walz.
Governor Walz was elected Governor of Minnesota the same year I was elected to Congress, so I have not had the chance to work with him personally. But ever since the announcement, my colleagues in the House who served with him in the decade before I arrived in D.C. have been totally over the moon, sharing their experiences and views about what an all-around great person he is.
While I don’t know him personally, I do know that he—a veteran, former teacher and high school football coach, and former Congressman—will make an exceptional vice president. Why? Not just because my friends think he’s great—which they do—but because he has a real record of delivering meaningful progress for his state as Governor—including ensuring abortion protections, passing common sense gun safety measures, and tackling child hunger and poverty through free school meals. He has delivered for our veterans in Congress. And, he has a history of winning tough races.
That last one is important because we know we have a very tough race ahead.
People across our community and across the country are rallying behind our candidates and, next week, we’ll make it official at the Democratic National Convention.
Let’s give them a strong boost of support! Will you split a contribution between the Harris-Walz campaign and mine? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe2408split_kh?refcode=lpfe2408split_kh]
I know they have what it takes to defeat Donald Trump and JD Vance this November and ensure the GOP’s dangerous Project 2025 agenda doesn’t become our reality. And I’ve spent a bunch of time this August working on our plans here in #TX07 to support them and Democrats up and down the ballot in Texas. To execute a winning campaign plan takes money and effort. Our campaigns need both!
So, today, I hope you will support our effort with a contribution that will help our campaign and theirs reach every voter we can. With so much at stake this election, and with Election Day less than three months away, I hope you will split any amount you can between their campaign and ours. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe2408split_kh?refcode=lpfe2408split_kh]
I hope you will also keep thinking about other ways to help, too. Soon, our team will send out more information about ways to volunteer for our campaign—from writing postcards, to knocking on doors, to making phone calls, to planting yard signs, and more. We need to do a lot of things to make sure we win back the House, hold on to the Senate, and send Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to the White House! I’m so glad to be a partner in that work with this incredible team in TX-07!
Together, we can do anything,
LizzieSignature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]

Recent reports have confirmed that the Israeli military is systematically committing heinous war crimes against Palestinians, [including raping Palestinian prisoners](https://substack.com/redirect/d21265c2-5770-4345-8218-72432cc185d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [bombing designated safe zones hundreds of times](https://substack.com/redirect/53902331-f36f-4c01-adb5-dffbfa91c91c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and using [Palestinian civilians as human shields as 'protocol'](https://substack.com/redirect/192588e2-08ca-42d9-b625-7da6b5042513?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). These acts of brutality are indefensible, yet they continue with no meaningful accountability. Even more troubling is the United States' response to these war crimes, which is to [send Netanyahu an additional $23.5 billion in military aid](https://substack.com/redirect/8ad53f67-a418-4862-911a-deab8a1e43de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in stark violation of U.S. and international human rights law.
**Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4362ae8a-9d2e-4faa-afa8-e2d5f5b5eb20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=147784983&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ3Nzg0OTgzLCJpYXQiOjE3MjM4Mjc2MzEsImV4cCI6MTcyNjQxOTYzMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.u6aNJaL7yqg1tWFI0g7YGupqPw-55_ruvAOrOxfi1u0)
The justification often cited by Israel for its indiscriminate bombing of Gaza is that "_Hamas uses human shields_." This claim has been used to rationalize the bombing of schools and hospitals, refugee centers and food distribution centers, apartment buildings, churches, and mosques. But now as reports from credible sources like Haaretz and The Guardian expose that over the last 10 months, it is the Israeli military that has systemically used Palestinians as human shields, the global response is relative silence. The UK Guardian [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/192588e2-08ca-42d9-b625-7da6b5042513?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Israeli soldiers are using Palestinian civilians as human shields in Gaza to enter and clear tunnels and buildings they suspect may have been booby-trapped. The practice was so widespread across different units fighting in Gaza that it could in effect be considered a "protocol", said Nadav Weiman, the executive director of Breaking the Silence, a group founded by Israeli combat veterans to document military abuses. "We heard it from different units, fighting in different times and different places inside Gaza," Weiman said. "Then we understood it's something a lot more widespread - or even, I could say, a protocol - in the IDF."
These are Israeli soldiers admitting that using Palestinians as human shields is not isolated, but "protocol." And likewise, consider the Israeli military's dehumanizing 'justification' to use Palestinians as human shields:
> One soldier had been told Palestinian civilians were being used to replace the dog units that search for explosives "because too many dogs had died", he added.
Sadly, this isn't the first time during this siege on Gaza that Palestinians have documented the Israeli military using them as human shields. In June a video emerged of a Palestinian strapped to the hood of an Israeli military vehicle.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8c74f061-ef0c-4cd0-8dff-d186103560fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
NPR [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/64a10d5d-2ead-4730-bb51-5a3d5c248bfb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that they spoke to the man's cousin who confirmed that the Israeli military shot at him, tortured him, and tied him to the hood of their jeep:
> The man's cousin, Ezer Azmi, said he witnessed the incident. He claims Israeli troops shot his cousin, who he says was left bleeding in the road for hours before they beat him and then placed him on the hood of the vehicle. "This is not acceptable to us or anyone else, nor anyone who fears God," Azmi told NPR. He said that his cousin was not involved in any terrorism activities.
Notably, this June incident was not in Gaza, but in the West Bank, [where Israeli settlers and extremists have launched unprecedented violence against Palestinian civilians](https://substack.com/redirect/b4ee023e-af8b-4fbd-9a05-1e59c362a458?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Likewise, the Israeli military faced no repercussions or limit in funding from the U.S. government for this documented war crime. But this is nothing new.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/65d7598e-c49a-4048-937d-a78effd12746?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Indeed, far from being an isolated incident, Israel's use of Palestinians as human shields goes back decades without consequence. So prevalent was this barbaric practice that way back in 2005 the Israeli Supreme Court was forced to issue a formal ban on the Israeli military using Palestinians for human shields. As The Guardian [confirmed way back then](https://substack.com/redirect/60e4d653-5f41-4144-91a6-c0deebc07092?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The Israeli high court yesterday ruled that **the army's long-standing practice of using Palestinian civilians as human shields in combat is illegal** under international law. It said the military's claim to have amended the procedure to allow civilians to "volunteer" to work with the army was still unacceptable because it was unlikely anyone would freely do so.
And despite this ruling, now nearly two decades later, Israeli soldiers once again admit that the use of Palestinians as human shields is "protocol." This revelation should be making headlines worldwide, yet it has barely registered in public discourse. The Leahy Laws, which prohibit the U.S. from providing military aid to foreign military units that commit gross human rights abuses, should apply here. Yet, the U.S. government continues to support Israel's military operations, effectively turning a blind eye to these documented atrocities. This decision is both morally indefensible and also sets a dangerous precedent for future misuse and abuse of military arms.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3d9e47b5-9b26-4396-b962-33755a046599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Netanyahu's actions are particularly egregious given the recent developments surrounding a potential ceasefire. [Hamas accepted a proposal for a ceasefire and hostage release--one that Netanyahu himself had proposed](https://substack.com/redirect/08955b76-eb1e-4dba-aacc-0039113eb2eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). However, Netanyahu then rejected his own proposal, choosing instead to continue his onslaught on Gaza, demanding a ceasefire from Hamas [while maintaining the right to continue bombing Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/ec22e622-8de4-4804-be79-954cb69feb8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is not the behavior of a leader seeking peace; it is the behavior of one committed to perpetuating violence and oppression. Most assuredly, our tax dollars should not be funding his war crimes.
It needs to be said, that notwithstanding the Israeli military's confirmed use of human shields, any attack on an Israeli hospital, school, or residence under the 'justification' that Israel hides behind human shields would be categorically condemned. The question therefore is, why don't Palestinian civilians get that same level of justice, protection, and humanity when Israel systemically bombs Palestinian hospitals, schools, mosques, churches, and homes in Gaza and the West Bank?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8c5454b9-b7cf-47a5-8260-0be3a5656347?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Recently, former [Speaker Nancy Pelosi joined more than 40 Democrats to demand a cessation of arms to Netanyahu](https://substack.com/redirect/068b6b30-c8c5-472b-ad54-e3d4219b490e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is a step in the right direction, but words alone are not enough. We need action. It is time for the international community, and particularly the United States, to confront and stop these war crimes. We cannot claim to stand for human rights while funding Netanyahu as he destroys Palestinian lives. The world cannot afford to look away any longer. It is long past time to end our complicity in this genocide, and demand justice for the Palestinian people.

Friends,
We know we’re on the verge of sounding like a broken record here, but you know how important we think conversation is. At every level of government, elected officials are supposed to talk to the people they work for. They’re supposed to hear their concerns, ideas, and thoughts. The bottom line is, representatives are elected to represent. No-show Nick hasn’t been doing his job.
You know what else really matters, come to think of it? Telling the truth. In fact, here on Long Island, we can smell BS from a mile away. While we’re not surprised No-show Nick is living up to his name, it’s not like he can tell the truth anyways. Because he's done absolutely nothing.
Look, we know LaLota’s a toady. But talking to your constituents is the bare minimum. He hasn’t held a town hall in two years. And when we confronted him about it, he lied about it. That’s a firing offense.
Why hasn't he held one? It’s certainly not because he’s too busy. We all know how little time he actually dedicates to representing Suffolk County. Is it because he’s lazy? Is it because he’s scared? Is it because he thinks his own constituents will show up just to heckle him?
We’re going to go with all of the above. His constituency is one person who lives in Mar-a-Lago (very, very, far away from our district).
We’ve called him out on this from the beginning, and now he’s taking notice. Apparently John’s comments made him angry. And what do MAGA Republicans like Nick LaLota do when somebody makes them angry with the truth? They take to Twitter and whine, lie, and troll. Extreme toady behavior.
We need somebody who shows up. Plain and simple. Not somebody who makes a phone call from outside the district or only shows up to entertain corporations. The thing is, finding common ground isn’t that hard. Anyone who spends more than five minutes talking to people in Suffolk county would know that. You have to ask yourself why Nick LaLota doesn’t get it.
Help us keep exposing him for the flunky he is >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general?refcode=0816]
-Team Avlon

body:
This is probably the hardest email I’ve ever written.

| |
---

Friend --

I wish things would have gone a different way...

This is the hardest email I've ever written.

**I 'm Mayra Flores, the America First Hispanic woman running in the biggest race in the nation.**

After we made history and flipped a blue seat red for the first time in 100 years, the Democrats threw the kitchen sink at me, **and I had to concede my race. ** | **Democrat Vicente Gonzalez holds back Republican surge, returns 34th Congressional District to Democratic control.**
---

Everyone expected me to just walk away - _but I 'm not someone who ever, ever gives up._

body:
https://www.tamiewilson.com/ [https://www.tamiewilson.com/]
Friends,
We’re heading to the DNC in Chicago, and I couldn’t be more excited to bring the energy and enthusiasm we’ve built here in Ohio to the national stage.
This is our chance to join fellow Democrats in rallying behind the Kamala Harris and Tim Walz ticket – a team representing the hope and progress our country desperately needs.
Democratic leaders and party members recognize the winning campaign we’ve created here in Ohio.
They see the energy, enthusiasm, and unwavering commitment to working people, and they know we have what it takes to defeat Jim Jordan.

All the way back in 1870, Hiram Rhodes Revels, a pastor and State Senator from Mississippi, was elected as the first Black US Senator. Since then, we've come a long way as a country. **But representation – like our democracy – is a work in progress, and I believe we can do better.**
Black Americans have long faced _far too many_ obstacles like: discrimination, lower pay, higher job instability – not to mention the racist voter suppression laws that Texas Republicans like Ted Cruz have championed, which make it harder for certain folks to vote.
**The bottom line is this: It's essential that our government reflects the people it represents.**
I'm ready to defeat Ted Cruz this November and fight to build a more perfect union for my boys and every kid in Texas. But unlike Ted Cruz, I don't have corporate special interests footing the bill for my campaign.

| Peter,

I've served a lot of different people over the years from all different walks of life.

No matter the district, one thing always remains the same – people just want to know you hear them. I've always rooted my public service in close ties to our community and the people I serve.

This election, I'm running to continue representing large parts of the district I know so well, but my constituent base is about to shift once again next year due to yet another round of redistricting. The run-up to the 2024 election is our critical time to engage those new to the district and ensure we have a high turnout to elect Democrats up and down the ballot in November.

body:
We desperately need a " private right to action " to protect voting rights. All that phrase means is that we, the people, can bring forward a lawsuit ourselves when we see wrongdoing in our elections.
This 8th Circuit decision strips us of that -- in a world where most legal action around voting rights comes from groups like ours and our partners, not from the U.S. Department of Justice.
We keep talking about this because it's so important, Team. RUSH $25 or more right now so we have the resources we need to fight rulings like this one and protect our right to vote across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=081624_2&amount=25]
AP: Federal appeals court deals a blow to Voting Rights Act, ruling that private plaintiffs can’t sue [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=081624_2&amount=25]
The recent 8th Circuit ruling is one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years . In the eight states impacted by the ruling, voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act.
We won’t sugarcoat this: That ruling is a crushing blow to many voting rights organizations, including Voter Action Project. If this ruling is not overturned by a higher court, it could unravel all of the great work organizations like ours are doing across the country — and allow dozens of unjust, unconstitutional voter restrictions to stand.
This attack on the Voting Rights Act highlights the importance of the other work we’ll do over the next year, as well: Voter registration, education, mobilization and more. As voter suppression laws become increasingly targeted and oppressive , our work to combat them must become smarter, stronger and more accessible to everyone.
Team, we have to fight harder than ever to protect the right to vote in 2024. Please pitch in $25 or whatever you can to stand with us in a crucial moment >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=081624_2&amount=25]

| | Georgia is ground zero for voter suppression in America: Aggressive legislation like SB 189 gets greenlit to make mass voter purges easier. Right-wing activists are sifting through voter registration lists to question their neighbors’ qualifications to vote. And now, MAGA-aligned state election board members are changing Georgia’s election rules — with less than 85 days until Election Day. Of course we’re fighting back, training new volunteers to help protect the freedom to vote and making calls and sending texts to reach voters. To continue this work at the pace that’s required, we urgently need support from grassroots donors across the country — people like you. [**Can you pitch in $30 to fund our programs and help ensure equal access to the ballot box?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90959113/492240410/-664593906?amount=30&refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20240816_f_sabotage2_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDBlOGRjNy1mOTViLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sQ-OtMboqm7EXLxI1lSY6ThAq0ShjK4CJIL52YhqUPk=) The MAGA operation has become more sophisticated since trying to overturn the 2020 election, taking different approaches to tamper with our democratic process. Starting with mass voter purges through challenges enabled by SB 202, and expanding their efforts through SB 189, they’re now advancing their strategy with challenges to the election certification process and by upending election administration. Right-wing activists are sifting through voter registration lists to question their neighbors’ qualifications to vote. And now, MAGA-aligned state election board members are changing Georgia’s election rules — with less than 85 days until Election Day. Of course we’re fighting back, training new volunteers to help protect the freedom to vote and making calls and sending texts to reach voters. To continue this work at the pace that’s required, we urgently need support from grassroots donors across the country — people like you. = The MAGA operation has become more sophisticated since trying to overturn the 2020 election, taking different approaches to tamper with our democratic process. Starting with mass voter purges through challenges enabled by SB 202, and expanding their efforts through SB 189, they’re now advancing their strategy with challenges to the election certification process and by upending election administration. We’re seeing a nationally coordinated scheme to keep ballot access as far out of reach as possible, especially for Black and brown, young, disabled, unhoused, and rural voters. They know our votes matter, which is why they’re trying so hard to silence us. = We’re in this fight together. subject: This is like rocket fuel for your mitochondria!
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Did you know that your
mitochondria are by far the most important key to healthy aging?
…and that It's possible to
make your mitochondria stronger and more efficient … and
even to increase the number of mitochondria in each and every
cell in your body?
Your mitochondria determine
whether you spring out of bed, ready to tackle anything…
Or whether you feel like you
start the day with no gas in the tank.

And it's all because your
mitochondria produce cellular energy.
When your cells are full of
energy, everything clicks.
Your brain is sharp, your body is
nimble, and you're raring to go.
The more energy in your cells,
the younger you feel.
Trouble is, around age 40 or so,
your mitochondria start producing less cellular energy. A lot
less.
Studies show that by the time
you're 60, your mitochondria struggle to make just HALF the
amount of cellular energy they churned out in your 30s.
But what if you could get your
mitochondria to start producing lots of cellular energy like they
did when you were younger?
The good news is, you can! And
you'll love how easy it is when you know how.
You'll find all the details here.

body:
Massive corporations have been taking advantage of the American people to line their own pockets for years.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240816-4208-footer&t=1&akid=4208%2E420207%2EvrroBb)
Massive corporations have been taking advantage of the American people to line their own pockets for years, Peter. When they raise prices, they just say it's because of inflation — yet their profits skyrocket at the same time.
**Nowhere is this more obvious than at the grocery store.** And it’s especially relevant here in Washington, where Kroger and Albertsons want to go through with a merger that would let them gouge customers even more.
**Thankfully, the Biden-Harris administration is already challenging that deal in court. And Kamala Harris has even bigger plans to address price gouging:**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240816.vn5OB-&refcode=em20240816-4208&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4208%2E420207%2EvrroBb)
[**Peter, will you split a donation between Kamala and Pramila’s campaigns today so we can keep up the momentum behind our movement?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240816.vn5OB-&refcode=em20240816-4208&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4208%2E420207%2EvrroBb)
VP Harris has a proven record of going after corporate greed and price gouging _and winning_. But even as president, she won’t be able to do it alone.
If we really want to tackle this issue, **we’ll need Congress to act as well**. And VP Harris knows that — which is why she’s calling on Congress to pass a federal ban on price gouging.
But as long as Mike Johnson or one of the other MAGA Republicans holds the Speaker’s gavel, that proposal is dead on arrival. **So it’s critical that we both elect Kamala _and_ flip the House this November.**
That’s why we’re reaching out right now. Big corporate interests (including many of the same corporations engaging in price gouging in the first place) are lining up to help Donald Trump and his allies come back into power. We’re counting on grassroots support to fight back and stop them.
[**So Peter, if you’re ready to send VP Harris to the White House and elect more progressives to Congress, will you split a donation between Kamala and Pramila’s campaigns today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240816.vn5OB-&refcode=em20240816-4208&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4208%2E420207%2EvrroBb)

| | At the end of July, I introduced the Ensuring Airline Resiliency to Reduce Delays and Cancellations Act. Last month, travelers faced unprecedented flight delays and cancellations due to systematic failures caused by a CrowdStrike outage. This technology meltdown left thousands of flights canceled and thousands more families and travelers stranded at airports across the country. **The flying public deserves a safe, smooth, and worry-free travel experience, and the airlines were unable to provide that.** The legislation I introduced will require airlines to enhance their operational resiliency plans, ensuring they will be thinking ahead and be better prepared for future large-scale disruptions. Airlines can and must do better. Flight delays and cancellations have increasingly impacted the flying public over the past several years. These delays and cancellations can have devastating consequences, and this legislation aims to mitigate these challenges in the future by encouraging airlines to act more proactively. **Every American deserves a safe and smooth travel experience.** More soon, _Rick_ | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:

* Gives Trump total control of the Executive Branch

EDUCATION
* Abolishes the Department of Education because it supports "woke propaganda"

ENVIRONMENT
* Bans any mention of "climate change"

HEALTHCARE
* Drastically cuts Medicare, Medicaid, and a host of other federal programs

IMMIGRATION
* Mass deportation of millions of immigrants

WOMEN'S REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOM
* Prohibits abortion and medical treatments used in providing it
* Bans words like "reproductive health" and "reproductive rights" from federal laws, grant applications, and regulations.

name: Justice Democrats
subject: Tell Harris-Walz: Support a ceasefire and arms embargo NOW!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

The carnage against civilians in Gaza has only continued as Israeli Prime
Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has refused to agree to a permanent ceasefire
deal while carpet-bombing most of the territory.

Homes, schools, and places of worship where Palestinian refugees are
gathering to survive are being targeted with bombs and missiles, killing
innocent men, women, and children. Disturbing reports of torture by the
Israeli military are rampant. At this point, at least 40,000 Palestinians
have been killed, which is more than likely an undercount. Tens of
thousands more have been injured, with millions displaced and facing
starvation.

Despite the ongoing massacres against innocent people, many of whom are
children and infants, the United States government has not stopped aiding
and abetting the Israeli government’s violence: just this week, the U.S.
agreed to give another $23.5 billion in military aid to Israel. This is
unacceptable.

While our Justice Democrats in Congress have called for a permanent
ceasefire and lasting peace since the beginning, more are joining them:
nearly 60 Democratic members have now signed a letter demanding the White
House halt all arms transfers to Israel. Even former Speaker Nancy Pelosi
has signed on.

It further goes to show that opposing genocide is NOT a fringe
position, Peter. And according to
Zeteo, a new poll from YouGov/IMEU Policy Project found “over a third of
voters in Pennsylvania, Arizona, and Georgia are more likely to vote for a
Democratic nominee who pledges to withhold weapons to Israel.”

Ending this humanitarian crisis is not only the right thing to do — it’s
what the people of this country want from their elected officials, and it
can shape November’s critical election results in key swing states.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/20240816-ceasefire-arms-embargo/?source=em20240816-35915&akid=35915%2E1203867%2Ehtj8-3 ]The Democratic Party is convening this coming week for the 2024
Democratic National Convention, which means this is the perfect time for
us to demand the Party and Harris-Walz campaign support a ceasefire in
Gaza and an arms embargo with Israel. Add your name to join us →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/20240816-ceasefire-arms-embargo/?source=em20240816-35915&akid=35915%2E1203867%2Ehtj8-3 ]Add Your Name

It’s beyond time for the Party and our new Democratic ticket to stand on
the right side of history and come out strongly in support of a ceasefire
and weapons embargo. Let’s make that clear to them in this crucial moment.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240816-35915-footer&t=1002&refcode2=35915_1203867_htj8-3&akid=35915%2E1203867%2Ehtj8-3

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. Peter, allow me to summarize in a few words, from Donald Trump’s perspective, the press conference he recently held at Mar-a-Lago.
_Kamala Harris’s campaign rallies are small. Mine are big.

If the 2020 election were not stolen from me, no bad things would have happened. Only good things would have happened.

With Democrats our economy is terrible. With me as president our economy was amazing._
**If that sounds insane, that’s because it is. Peter, here is the truth:**

Kamala Harris is drawing thousands of people to her campaign rallies. Trump’s campaign schedule is nonexistent.

During Trump’s presidency, the economy went down, crime went up, and he mismanaged a once-in-a-century global pandemic. Joe Biden and Kamala Harris are leading an economic comeback.

Trump was the first president since Herbert Hoover to _lose jobs._ **The Biden-Harris Administration has created 15 million.**

If Trump’s press conference showed us one thing, it’s that Democrats are focused on the future, and Trump’s MAGA movement is trying to take us back in time.

[We have to win up and down the ballot in California to defend the Senate, retake the House, and defeat Trump.
