Kamala Harris bragged that she was the last person Joe Biden consulted before the withdrawal, and stated unequivocally that she was “comfortable” with the decision. Their horrendous withdrawal left behind $7 BILLION in military equipment, American citizens and their dependents, and cost 13 American service members their lives. Terrorists parading American military equipment is the foreign policy legacy of the Biden-Harris Administration, along with countless other failures that their weakness on the world stage has created. Do not forget Kamala Harris’s role in the chaos we are seeing around the world. | | | | BAD NEWS: We are officially SOLD OUT of the Sidewinder Holster System. GOOD NEWS: Our next batch of holsters is in production. , you'll get 10% off your purchase. Orders ship in a couple of weeks. MORE GOOD NEWS: You're making a real difference with your purchase. Endex is my new campaign store. Which means the profits from every Sidewinder, along with all the other cool merch we've got, goes to fund Republican races in tight House districts across the country. I don't make a dime off any of these promotions - the entire point is to help build a strong Republican majority in Congress for President Trump's next term. | | EVEN THE LIBERAL MEDIA IS BEGGING KAMALA FOR JUST ONE INTERVIEW | | | | Not one interview. Not one press conference. This is not the behavior of someone asking the American people to elect her to lead in difficult times. It’s the behavior of a coward who can’t answer simple questions on important policies. We know what we get with Trump. Our enemies feared us, our economy was strong, and our future was hopeful. Kamala doesn’t want to do interviews because she doesn’t want to answer for her own failures in office. She doesn’t want to answer why she has changed her position on virtually every issue she campaigned on four years ago. Does she still support banning fracking? Does she still support Medicare for All? Does she still support eliminating private health insurance? Does she still support decriminalizing illegal immigration? Does she still support abolishing ICE? Does she still support providing free health care to illegal immigrants? She said all of these things - on the record and on camera - the last time she ran for president. This time, she’s hiding her true beliefs for obvious reasons. She wants to trick the American people into thinking she’s a “fresh face.” She’s not. She’s the one who let our border become a disaster, attacks our energy industry, and wants to raise our taxes. It’s a simple choice in November. | | GOVERNOR WALZ'S SERVICE RECORD UNDER SCRUTINY | | | | Since running for Governor of Minnesota, Tim Walz has been caught in controversy for exaggerating his military record. Way too many veterans in politics embellish their military career because they know you don’t know the difference. It’s disgusting. I see it from both sides of the aisle. Even the word “combat” itself is plagued by purposeful misdirection. A lot of vets say they were deployed “into combat.” It’s often bullshit. Very few of us actually leave the safety of the base, whether in Iraq or Afghanistan. But everyone who deploys is technically deployed in a “combat zone,” and so they advertise “combat experience” on their resumes. Nothing wrong with serving in a role that doesn’t require combat. It’s more than most people have done. But if you’re trying to run for office and using “combat” as a way to gain credibility, that’s wrong. There’s a lot of questions of Walz that I don’t yet know the answer to. But I do know he shouldn’t be talking about “carrying weapons into combat” when he did no such thing. Furthermore, it sounds like he has lied about his rank of Retired Command Sergeant Major. The Harris campaign had to scrub his rank from their website. Here’s the problem with this duplicity: it proves Tim Walz, just like Kamala Harris, will say and do anything to get elected, even if it means deliberately altering their personal biographies or the positions they hold on the important issues. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

subject: Honest

body:
Kids that grow up the way I did do not become Senators. I’m the son of a single mom. Between me and my three sisters, we could barely make ends meet.
#

Peter -
I’ve got to be completely honest: Kids that grow up the way I did do not become Senators.
I’m the son of a single mom. Between me and my three sisters, we could barely make ends meet.
But I was lucky — I had my mom looking out for me. As I got older, I had teachers and members of my community looking out for me. When I went to Iraq, I had my Marines looking out for me.
And today, as we run one of the most competitive races in the country, I’m still incredibly lucky. I’ve got you with me, and more than 300,000 people have chipped in to keep us going. .
And honestly, I never thought I’d need to ask folks like you to do more than you already have to take back this Senate seat. But that’s what I need you to do.
I know you probably didn’t wake up this morning thinking you were going to make a donation to my campaign, but if we’re going to defeat Kari Lake that’s what I need you to do.

## You can't make this up...
The Harris Team has been editing headlines and stories from media outlets - and they don't care.
The Harris campaign has been editing news headlines and descriptions within Google search ads that make it appear as if the Guardian, Reuters, CBS News and other major publishers are on her side, Axios has found.

## BLANK Slate:
Kamala Harris is a blank slate - and the polls show it
A new poll from the Media Research Center shows that MOST Democrats and Independents don't know where she stands -- and it's obvious she wants to keep it that way. No interviews, no press conferences and no policy papers. AND...she is getting away with it. In 30 years of campaigns I have never seen anything like this. No wonder legacy media is dying - no one is doing journalism.

body:
We need reform, and we need it now.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90966981/492267537/1328794144?refcode=ea.11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjExYjNlZDNiLTA5NWMtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qghXRiNDeYzo0bbn9z6lqwkyUGtUO-JYpp-YmKWFRXo=&emci=19b1615d-295b-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105)
---
The Supreme Court has made some _deeply troubling_ decisions lately — decisions that threaten our rights, our environment, and the very fabric of our democracy. Here’s some good news: President Biden proposed several bold reforms to address these issues, including **term limits for Supreme Court justices** to end lifetime appointments and create a more predictable and fair nomination process and a **binding code of conduct for justices** , which would enforce ethical standards and hold justices accountable for their actions. **But we want to hear from you: Do you support reforming the Supreme Court?** | [**YES**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90966982/492267538/-957683364?refcode=ea.11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjExYjNlZDNiLTA5NWMtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qghXRiNDeYzo0bbn9z6lqwkyUGtUO-JYpp-YmKWFRXo=&emci=19b1615d-295b-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105) | [**NO**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90966983/492267539/-957683364?refcode=ea.11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjExYjNlZDNiLTA5NWMtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qghXRiNDeYzo0bbn9z6lqwkyUGtUO-JYpp-YmKWFRXo=&emci=19b1615d-295b-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105)
---|---
We’re all aware of the majority’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , but few know about the Court’s decision to destroy the _Chevron_ doctrine earlier this year, which served as a precedent for over 40 years of environmental protections.
The decision to strike down _Chevron_ effectively stripped the EPA of its power to regulate based on science and expertise, giving unelected judges the final say on critical and complex environmental issues. _Yes — justices like Clarence Thomas and Brett Kavanaugh._
The Supreme Court even granted presidential immunity from federal prosecution for any official actions during their tenure — giving a free pass to abuses of power and demolishing any shred of accountability.
And let’s not forget the scandals. 🙄 Reports of billionaires giving millions of dollars in unreported lavish gifts and luxury vacations to influence the Court’s decisions are making headlines. _Clarence Thomas, we’re looking at you._
We’re at a tipping point. The Supreme Court is not just out of touch; it’s out of control. It’s time for serious reform to restore integrity and balance to our highest court.
While these reforms face an uphill battle in a divided Congress, they highlight the urgent need for change.
At the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we know that the fight for a sustainable future is inseparable from the fight for a fair and accountable judiciary.
**We need a Supreme Court that upholds justice and protects our planet — not one that panders to billionaires and corporate interests. And we need to know if you’re with us. Do you agree that it’s time to reform the Supreme Court?**
[**YES**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90966984/492267540/-957683364?refcode=ea.11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjExYjNlZDNiLTA5NWMtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qghXRiNDeYzo0bbn9z6lqwkyUGtUO-JYpp-YmKWFRXo=&emci=19b1615d-295b-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105) | [**NO**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90966985/492267541/-957683364?refcode=ea.11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjExYjNlZDNiLTA5NWMtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qghXRiNDeYzo0bbn9z6lqwkyUGtUO-JYpp-YmKWFRXo=&emci=19b1615d-295b-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=11b3ed3b-095c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105)

clean_body: We need reform, and we need it now. | The Supreme Court has made some deeply troubling decisions lately — decisions that threaten our rights, our environment, and the very fabric of our democracy. Here’s some good news: President Biden proposed several bold reforms to address these issues, including term limits for Supreme Court justices to end lifetime appointments and create a more predictable and fair nomination process and a binding code of conduct for justices , which would enforce ethical standards and hold justices accountable for their actions. But we want to hear from you: Do you support reforming the Supreme Court? | | ---|--- We’re all aware of the majority’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade , but few know about the Court’s decision to destroy the Chevron doctrine earlier this year, which served as a precedent for over 40 years of environmental protections. The decision to strike down Chevron effectively stripped the EPA of its power to regulate based on science and expertise, giving unelected judges the final say on critical and complex environmental issues. Yes — justices like Clarence Thomas and Brett Kavanaugh. The Supreme Court even granted presidential immunity from federal prosecution for any official actions during their tenure — giving a free pass to abuses of power and demolishing any shred of accountability. And let’s not forget the scandals. 🙄 Reports of billionaires giving millions of dollars in unreported lavish gifts and luxury vacations to influence the Court’s decisions are making headlines. Clarence Thomas, we’re looking at you. We’re at a tipping point. The Supreme Court is not just out of touch; it’s out of control. It’s time for serious reform to restore integrity and balance to our highest court. While these reforms face an uphill battle in a divided Congress, they highlight the urgent need for change. At the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we know that the fight for a sustainable future is inseparable from the fight for a fair and accountable judiciary. We need a Supreme Court that upholds justice and protects our planet — not one that panders to billionaires and corporate interests. And we need to know if you’re with us. Do you agree that it’s time to reform the Supreme Court? | ---|--- Thanks for your response. subject: Just One Month Until Voting Begins!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Jeremy Shaffer
body:
| | | | |
---
| [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/66d4155f94ec/im-running-and-i-need-your-support-12707570?e=8c80cba7e7)
---
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=baf89e3d84&e=8c80cba7e7)
| Dear ,
It’s hard to believe that in just one month, the first votes will be cast here in Pennsylvania! With mail-in voting starting 50 days before Election Day, ballots will begin to be sent out on September 16th in Allegheny and other counties. Although the current system may have its flaws, we must navigate the rules effectively to secure victory!
I strongly encourage you to request your mail-in ballot as soon as possible at[ http://vote.pa.gov/](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=4e0bb12f61&e=8c80cba7e7). While your vote remains confidential, requesting and returning your ballot is public information. Our campaign uses this to target and engage mail-in voters effectively. By doing so, you help us cut outreach costs and make a $20-equivalent contribution, allowing us to focus our resources where they’re most needed.

If you don’t submit your mail-in ballot in time, don’t worry—just visit your polling place on Election Day and cast a provisional ballot. As your future state legislator, I am committed to ensuring our elections remain free, fair, and accessible to anyone who wants to participate in our democratic process.
**Pine Community Day Recap:**
We had a fantastic time at Pine Community Day, engaging with hundreds of friends and supporters. The energy and enthusiasm were truly inspiring. It was also a pleasure to support my friend Rob Mercuri, our current State Representative, and his dedicated team. I’m fully backing Rob in his bid for Congress, and if you’re in the 17th Congressional District, I encourage you to support him as well. Together, we can make meaningful improvements at both the state and local levels.

---
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=b76f375c8e&e=8c80cba7e7)
| **Special Thanks to Our Local Committees:**
A heartfelt thank you to the West Deer and Marshall Republican Committees! Your hard work in preparing and sending out information to thousands of voters is invaluable. Your efforts are crucial in informing voters about candidates and early voting procedures.
---
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=d3824796df&e=8c80cba7e7)
| **Join Us for Door Knocking and Literature Drops:**
This Sunday (8/18) at 1 PM, we’ll be canvassing neighborhoods across the district. We would greatly appreciate any help you can provide—whether it’s door knocking, talking with voters, or simply dropping literature. clean_body: | | | | | | | Dear , It’s hard to believe that in just one month, the first votes will be cast here in Pennsylvania! With mail-in voting starting 50 days before Election Day, ballots will begin to be sent out on September 16th in Allegheny and other counties. Although the current system may have its flaws, we must navigate the rules effectively to secure victory! I strongly encourage you to request your mail-in ballot as soon as possible at. While your vote remains confidential, requesting and returning your ballot is public information. Our campaign uses this to target and engage mail-in voters effectively. By doing so, you help us cut outreach costs and make a $20-equivalent contribution, allowing us to focus our resources where they’re most needed. If you don’t submit your mail-in ballot in time, don’t worry—just visit your polling place on Election Day and cast a provisional ballot. As your future state legislator, I am committed to ensuring our elections remain free, fair, and accessible to anyone who wants to participate in our democratic process. Pine Community Day Recap: We had a fantastic time at Pine Community Day, engaging with hundreds of friends and supporters. The energy and enthusiasm were truly inspiring. It was also a pleasure to support my friend Rob Mercuri, our current State Representative, and his dedicated team. We only got 82 days to make this thing happen -- to bring a sense of joy each and every day and to show our commitment to making life a little easier for regular people.
_That's all politics is about, right?_
You know, my mom and dad taught me to always show generosity toward my neighbors and work for the common good. And now is our moment.

clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Next Week is the Democratic National Convention Next week, the Windy City will host the Democratic National Convention from Monday, Aug. 19-Thursday, Aug. 22. The event caps off the whirlwind the last few weeks have been, following Biden’s drop out and the Harris-Walz ticket’s subsequent rise. During the convention, their nomination for president and vice president will be made official. To represent the Hoosier State, the Indiana Democratic Party is sending 88 delegates to the convention. Recent U.S. Ambassador to the Vatican and former U.S. Senator Joe Donnelly is to serve as chair. “We’re incredibly proud to have a champion for Hoosier families and someone who has seen first hand the amazing accomplishments of the Biden-Harris administration leading our delegation forward in Chicago in Ambassador Joe Donnelly,” said Indiana Democratic Party Chair Mike Schmuhl in a June press release. In order to ensure you stay up-to-date on all convention happenings, we encourage you to follow INDems on , , and , where we will be posting coverage from the four day event. Jim Banks Continues to Avoid Debate Invitation In early June, the Indiana Debate Commission extended invitations to US Senate candidates Democrat Valerie McCray, Libertarian Andrew Horning and Republican Jim Banks to participate in a debate ahead of the November election. While McCray and Horning quickly expressed their willingness, Banks declined to respond. Despite being a current US Rep, Banks has shied away from the invitation for months, a disservice to Hoosier voters that deserve to know what agenda he plans on pushing if reelected. His hesitancy is indicative of his leadership style: Indecisive, divisive, and harmful to our state. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. After receiving over 8,000 questions, comments, and concerns from Hoosier regarding the proposed changes to Indiana high school graduation requirements, the Indiana Department of Education (IDOE) revealed an . Indiana State House Democratic leader Phil GiaQuinta commended the IDOE’s willingness to adapt, and expressed his support for continued collaboration. “I would like to thank the public for their response and engagement on this issue. Through grassroots advocacy, the public was able to positively influence the diploma proposal. We hope the SBOE and IDOE keep their word to proceed with full transparency and continue to take public input into consideration.” GiaQuinta said via a press release. The second draft was released following the IDOE’s receipt of letters from leaders of various Indiana universities such as Purdue and IU. , they expressed their concern over the requirement’s lack of rigor and failure to meet university admission standards. **** State Rep. Mitch Gore is prepared to continue his work on behalf of all Hoosiers working, playing, and living in Indiana’s 89th District. He was elected in 2020, and throughout his tenure in the General Assembly he has become known for authoring law enforcement reforms, expanding affordable healthcare, and improving access to mental healthcare and addiction counseling. Friends, let’s talk about this:
Democrats have seen incredible momentum the past few weeks, and I’m so excited about that. Watching enthusiasm skyrocket throughout our party, from folks of all ages and backgrounds, has been remarkable, and this November we have the chance to make history and protect our democracy by electing Kamala Harris.
But the truth is that we’re still the underdogs in this election cycle, and we need to act like it.
We can’t take our foot off the gas for one second. Donald Trump has spent YEARS building up his campaign, and if Democrats are going to not just compete with him but soundly defeat both him and JD Vance, we need to keep stepping things up.
My team is working to boost our fundraising numbers before we get to September, so today I’m asking for your help.
Will you make an online contribution of any amount today so we can meet our goals and keep building up the momentum and power we’ll need to win big in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

# “Brat Summer to Madam President"
---
|
Hey Everyone,
I know you're probably getting a lot of emails from my dad—trust me, I do too, and I’m just down the hall from him! Growing up, our home was always a hub for political events. My dad would host senators, governors, and even presidents. I still remember the time I shared my birthday party with Congressman Brad Sherman’s fundraiser; I’ve still got a comb from that day to prove it.
While I’ve always admired my dad’s ability to make a difference, I never really got involved in his political efforts—until I met Kamala. When she came and gave a speech at our home while running for California Attorney General, her passion and excitement inspired me to get involved. Since then, she has become like an auntie to me. In fact, we often joke that we have a guest room in our home dedicated just for her visits.
This past month, just a few days before she became the nominee, we hosted her at our home again. It was an incredibly inspiring experience, hearing her words and seeing firsthand what her campaign means to women, South Asians, immigrants, and so many Americans who just can’t take another four years of Trump’s chaos and divisiveness.
Kamala truly understands the challenges that women, especially those in my generation, face. As a South Asian, mixed-race woman, and the daughter of immigrants, her story has given me the courage to pursue my own dreams without hesitation. _(Sorry, Dad, I’m not running for president!) B_ ut as excited as I am about Kamala, I’m equally terrified at the thought of another four years under Trump’s leadership—with its endless lies, xenophobic policies, and lack of support for our generation in accessing education, securing good jobs, and owning homes. I fear that millions in my generation may never fully recover.
While I may not be as politically inclined as my brilliant father—you guys know he’s a full-time doctor saving lives, right?—I do believe in Kamala’s character, experience, and compassion. Most importantly, I believe it’s time for a woman to lead our nation. Kamala has the potential to be a great president, but she needs our support.
Please consider contributing to our grassroots fundraising efforts to ensure that Kamala’s "Brat Summer" turns into a victory this fall. [**Donate Now!**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=21c9c10dd5&e=7b1b739a89) Thank you for considering this request. And rest assured, if you donate, I’ll make sure my dad sends fewer emails—I promise!
Best,
Maaeda
P.S. If you’re not able to donate, please look for opportunities to volunteer your time with the local campaign, convince a neighbor to vote (especially in Nevada, Michigan and Pennsylvania), and be active on social media to get the truth out about Kamala and combat misinformation. It all adds up and makes a difference. For more info, check out [**KamalaHarris.com** ](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=1e0f46c90b&e=7b1b739a89) or her TikTok [**#KamalaHarris.**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=c0d5faed59&e=7b1b739a89)

| | _**Successful Super Saturdays**_
---
| | Friends, Another successful Super Saturday in the books! Thanks to the help of all you working alongside our team, we had a big weekend. All across the State we knocked doors and spread our message of unity, freedom, and opportunity to local communities. We can't thank our county chairs, candidates, and volunteers that helped amplify our message enough. Our next Super Saturday will be August 24th and we hope to see you all there, as we continue our momentum and make sure this November we get out as many Republican voters as possible. Up and down the ballot, Republican Hoosier values are on the ticket. Jennifer McCormick and the Indiana Democrats continue to fail to bring any real policy to the table, all the while supporting the radical liberal ticket of Harris-Walz. Not to mention her support of the Biden-Harris administration who has allowed an open border, crippling inflation, and lawlessness. The election this November is not just another election, it is an election that will change the future of America. It is up to us to make sure that future is one that continues to have Republican values represented. Thank you all for what you do!

_**Kamala's Afraid to Answer Questions**_
---
Kamala Harris is going on 26 days since she and a handful of Democrat Party elites pushed Biden off the ticket. It has also been 26 days of refusing to take part in any interviews or press conferences, ducking questions from the media. As we approach the Democratic National Convention, exactly what questions is Kamala afraid to answer?
---
* What is your plan for our economy?
* Under the Biden-Harris administration, inflation has gone up over 20%, crushing American families and budgets.

* Will you secure the border?
* Under border czar Harris, the southern border has been left wide open for all to enter.
* There have been over 10 million illegal border crossings since Harris was named the border czar.

* How will you bring stability overseas?
* Under the Biden-Harris administration, one of our strongest allies, Israel, was invaded and still faces a war with Palestine.
* Our ally, Ukraine, was invaded and is still at war with Russia.
* The Afghanistan withdrawal was a complete failure resulting in the deaths of 13 American servicemen, including a Hoosier from Logansport, IN.

* Why did you choose Tim Walz as your running mate?
* Tim Walz supports sanctuary cities, signed one of the most liberal abortion laws in the country as governor of Minnesota, and is just as radical as his partner Kamala Harris.

body:
Vote Ryan Mackenzie | | | | | |
---
| Friends,
We are just under 12 weeks until the November 5th general election, and our campaign is stronger than ever. I am working hard every day to talk to voters all across the district about the critical issues in this election, and I need your help now more than ever. Please read on or visit my [website](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=87843c3977&e=5ccada9200) to see all the ways that you can help my campaign.
Here is what I was up to this week:
* **Yard Signs Available**
* **National Night Out**
* **Around the District**

Sincerely,
Ryan Mackenzie
---
|
---
|
**Yard Signs Available**
Yard signs are now available! If you would like a yard sign for your yard please sign-up below. Signs are also available Monday-Friday 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM at 1125 S Cedar Crest Blvd. Allentown PA. (Bottom Floor)
---
[Sign Up For A Yard Sign](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=cc256477c7&e=5ccada9200)
|
---
| **National Night Out**
Despite some rough weather, I was able to attend a local Lower Macungie National Night out event with law enforcement and first responders in our community. Thank you to all the police officers and first responders that work to keep us safe every day.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
| **Around the District**
This week, the team and I were busy knocking on doors, making phone calls and going to events. I was able to attend a motorcycle event that raises money for law enforcement, the Carbon County Fair, Musikfest, and more. As always, a special thanks goes out to all our incredible volunteers who make our work possible.

Here’s why this court case is so important:
|

Hey Peter, we’ve got an update for you on a case that’s critical for our movement: Voters supported by one of our affiliates just filed an appeal to help protect equal representation for Black voters in Louisiana.
Earlier this year, a lower court wrongly struck down the state’s Voting Rights Act-compliant map that created two congressional districts where Black voters could elect the candidates of their choice. Voters have managed to keep the map in place for this fall’s election, but what happens next is critical. Now Louisiana voters supported by our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation, are appealing to the Supreme Court to ensure their voices are heard, in an effort to overturn the lower court’s decision.
While this battle plays out in court, All On The Line is working across the country to end map manipulation that silences the will of the people.

And that’s why you and other All On The Line supporters stand ready, before this election and beyond, to speak out against any attempt to undermine our democracy.** **

Earlier this year, a lower court wrongly struck down the state’s Voting Rights Act-compliant map that created two congressional districts where Black voters could elect the candidates of their choice. Voters have managed to keep the map in place for this fall’s election, but what happens next is critical. Now Louisiana voters supported by our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation, are appealing to the Supreme Court to ensure their voices are heard, in an effort to overturn the lower court’s decision. While this battle plays out in court, All On The Line is working across the country to end map manipulation that silences the will of the people. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Here’s why this court case in Louisiana is so critical: Black Louisianians make up about one-third of the state’s population, but if the map is overturned before the 2026 elections, Black voters would only have the opportunity to elect the candidate of their choice in just one of the state’s six congressional districts. It’s appalling. That’s why voters supported by our affiliate fought for — and won — the ability to use the new map in November’s election while this case is pending. And that’s why you and other All On The Line supporters stand ready, before this election and beyond, to speak out against any attempt to undermine our democracy. Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
4Trump 4Win Crypto Project Makes Trailblazing, Historic Donation in Cryptocurrency in Support of Trump’s Re-Election (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/4trump-4win-crypto-project-makes-trailblazing-historic-donation-in-cryptocurrency-in-support-of-trumps-re-election.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e6ba34c06a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Former President Donald Trump made remarks to the Bitcoin Conference in Nashville. (Doug Mills/The New York Times)
By Illinois Review

The cryptocurrency community is showing its support for President Donald Trump’s re-election in a historic and pioneering way, as the 4Trump 4Win (https://trump4win.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e6ba34c06a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) crypto project has pledged to donate 10 percent of its supply to help secure Trump’s victory in November.

As the project states (https://trump4win.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e6ba34c06a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , “Our mission is to support President Donald J. Trump, who has declared himself the ‘Crypto President,’ in his campaign for the 47th presidential election of the United States.” The project also spoke highly of the Trump’s administration’s policies, citing, “We firmly believe that President Trump’s administration has significantly improved the standard of living for all citizens.”

And in his next term, “as the Crypto President, he is committed to enhancing the DEFI (Decentralized Finance) ecosystem, which is currently way too restricted. Our goal is to mobilize resources and garner support to ensure his continued leadership and progress.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/4trump-4win-crypto-project-makes-trailblazing-historic-donation-in-cryptocurrency-in-support-of-trumps-re-election.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e6ba34c06a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
In June during a fundraiser in San Francisco with tech entrepreneurs, hosted by venture capitalists David Sacks and Chamath Palihapitiya, Trump said he would be the “Crypto President.” (https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-pitches-himself-crypto-president-san-francisco-tech-fundraiser-2024-06-07/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e6ba34c06a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) The crypto industry remains a target of regulators, but the support of President Trump could help ease tensions amongst the crypto community and federal regulators.

The list of high profile tech venture capitalists and crypto investors who are supporting Trump is growing, as they cite burdensome regulations within the industry as the main reason for their pivot in supporting the former president’s campaign.

name: Shelby County Republican Party
subject: UPDATE: Shelby County Republican Party News (August 16, 2024)
body:
Hello Again Shelby County Patriots,

The Meet the Candidates Night on September 3rd is going to be huge! We’re
even more convinced that it has the potential to fill to capacity quickly,
and we may need to cut off reservations at some point. So, if you plan to
come, RSVP quickly. When you do, you will be sent more detailed
information about the flow of the evening.

[image: Full Slate of Shelby GOP-2.JPEG]

We have over 120 RSVPs in less than 5 full days, just advertising via email
and on FB.

The following ad will appear on the bottom of page 1 of the SDN on
Saturday, August 17 & 24.

If you plan on coming, RSVP ASAP. Send an email to ShelbyGOPrsvp@gmail.com
with the names of all members of your party.

[image: AIM70376227 Shelby Co Republican Banner 8-1524.jpeg]

Additionally, please consider coming to our next three meetings and other
important events.

All Republican Party meetings start at 6:00 PM and are held at Calvary
United Baptist Church, 9480 County Rd 25A, Sidney, Oh 45365.

Tuesday, August 20, 2024
Garrett Arnold, the State Director of Ohio for the Trump campaign is
expected to be there.

Tuesday, September 17, 2024
Joshua Lisec; Co-Author with Jack Posobiec, of "Unhumans: The Secret
History of Communist Revolutions (and How to Crush Them)“ is our expected
speaker.

Tuesday, October 15, 2024
We’re still working on the program for this one.

Other events on the horizon:

Canceled: Lake Loramie Trump Flotilla; Saturday, August 31, 2024.

Every Saturday Morning from Sep 7 until election day, we will have a tent
set up on the town square in Sidney (during the Farmer’s Market) passing
out signs and literature from 8:00 AM to Noon. We set up on a vacant lot
with lots of space across the street from the market.

Cheers...Dan Cecil, Chairman
(937) 206-2970
cecilda.usaf@gmail.com

body:
And our efforts have been recognized by the Harris-Walz campaign
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90972983/492288184/664783965?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjNhNDZlNC0xODVjLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UMkDb3dfGAI3mnMxQE7XoQZ4ts-TTWA7wqMlDmRNE_o=&emci=7e8b92c3-135c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=c23a46e4-185c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=864787)
Hi Peter,
The **Democratic National Convention** is next week in Chicago, and Care in Action will be there loud and proud!
Care is an essential issue, and we’re putting it front and center: we’re leading events on the care agenda and building power to elect Care Champions.
**And our work has had an instant impact:** The Harris‐Walz campaign unveiled its economic agenda today, positioning the care economy as a central pillar of its platform leading into the convention.
The proposed agenda includes critical policies like reducing grocery prices and healthcare expenses, and expanding paid leave and the child tax credit — offering renewed hope for a future where working families can thrive.
[**_You can read our press release with my full response to the Harris-Walz campaign’s commitment to supporting care workers and families:_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90972985/492288186/-1204927703?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjNhNDZlNC0xODVjLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UMkDb3dfGAI3mnMxQE7XoQZ4ts-TTWA7wqMlDmRNE_o=&emci=7e8b92c3-135c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=c23a46e4-185c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=864787)
[READ OUR PRESS RELEASE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90972987/492288188/-1204927703?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjNhNDZlNC0xODVjLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UMkDb3dfGAI3mnMxQE7XoQZ4ts-TTWA7wqMlDmRNE_o=&emci=7e8b92c3-135c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=c23a46e4-185c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=864787)
_Check out all the events we’re leading at the Democratic National Convention:_
**_Monday, August 19th_**

**⇨** **Care Can’t Wait: Skyline Soiree** — We’re celebrating the accomplishments of this care coalition with care champions and leaders!

**_Tuesday, August 20th_**

**⇨** **Women’s Caucus panel** — Our senior advisor Ai‐jen Poo is a featured special guest.

**⇨** **Our Economy Runs on Care: Care Can’t Wait** — hosted by the Democratic National Convention, we’re convening a panel of care movement leaders, caregivers, and Members of Congress.

**_Wednesday, August 21st_**

**⇨** **Winning and Delivering on Democracy, Abortion and Care: A Salon Conversation** — a special event with powerful women leaders, activists, and movement makers about how to win the caring, compassionate, and equitable democracy we deserve.

**⇨** **Future Is Now: A Celebration of Firsts** — a celebration for the women who are shaping the future of democracy and preparing to elect our care champions.

**_Thursday, August 22nd_**

**⇨** **Democratic Mayors Association panel** — hosted by the Democratic National Convention, a conversation with Latino leaders, mayors, and Ai‐jen Poo as a special guest.

**⇨** **And so much more!**
---

clean_body: And our efforts have been recognized by the Harris-Walz campaign Hi Peter, The Democratic National Convention is next week in Chicago, and Care in Action will be there loud and proud! Care is an essential issue, and we’re putting it front and center: we’re leading events on the care agenda and building power to elect Care Champions. And our work has had an instant impact: The Harris‐Walz campaign unveiled its economic agenda today, positioning the care economy as a central pillar of its platform leading into the convention. The proposed agenda includes critical policies like reducing grocery prices and healthcare expenses, and expanding paid leave and the child tax credit — offering renewed hope for a future where working families can thrive. Check out all the events we’re leading at the Democratic National Convention: Monday, August 19th ⇨ Care Can’t Wait: Skyline Soiree — We’re celebrating the accomplishments of this care coalition with care champions and leaders! Tuesday, August 20th ⇨ Women’s Caucus panel — Our senior advisor Ai‐jen Poo is a featured special guest. ⇨ Our Economy Runs on Care: Care Can’t Wait — hosted by the Democratic National Convention, we’re convening a panel of care movement leaders, caregivers, and Members of Congress. Wednesday, August 21st ⇨ Winning and Delivering on Democracy, Abortion and Care: A Salon Conversation — a special event with powerful women leaders, activists, and movement makers about how to win the caring, compassionate, and equitable democracy we deserve. ⇨ Future Is Now: A Celebration of Firsts — a celebration for the women who are shaping the future of democracy and preparing to elect our care champions. Thursday, August 22nd ⇨ Democratic Mayors Association panel — hosted by the Democratic National Convention, a conversation with Latino leaders, mayors, and Ai‐jen Poo as a special guest. ⇨ And so much more! These exciting events wouldn’t be possible without the support of the domestic workers, families and advocates in our movement. Now, we need your help to ensure care remains a key issue in this year’s elections and beyond, and to elect Care Champions to office! Stay tuned for more content from the DNC! Hillary Holley Executive Director | Care in Action

Hey there,
I just took a look at our ActBlue account and I just wanted to say thank you, friend.
When I wrote to you last month, I was worried. We were being outraised by Trump in Q2 and over the past few weeks you really stepped up to help us close the gap.

**We’re gaining momentum and it’s all because of your support.**
****
* Cook Political Report recently updated NV's presidential race rating from Lean R to Toss Up.
* A recent poll from Equis Research showed Harris gaining support among Latino voters in Nevada and other battleground states.
* In a poll of likely voters, Senator Jacky Rosen leads over Sam Brown and we _have_ to re-elect Rosen for Democrats to keep the majority in the Senate.

| | | Peter, We’ve got a _lot_ to catch up on since our last WFP newsletter. Read on for more information on our work around the presidential election, key congressional races, and more — as well as how you can get involved this month!
* * *
**_WFP ENDORSES KAMALA HARRIS FOR PRESIDENT_** **Last month, Working Families Party members, chapters, and party leaders voted overwhelmingly to endorse Kamala Harris for President of the United States, with 95% of the total vote in support.[WFP National Director Maurice Mitchell explains how electing Kamala Harris is a key part of our plan to win for working people.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.A3cd-kVlFz1CzUMSYeTvVZ7cG3rz3Zyf9b9lh8DNvcbSheQDoYfbBPLM2Zu4OVQ60lP9iJfTE7U-8UrM4h2VXVD1spCQ9qitOt0E9ixlXp3pNrvS_fmYcHwBYh63wKyXvPL5Fe5RmbWpx_pyCDcqF-IocTK62LkEslXFrr7N5vPvLDOPvle39j6UkpKGzKdBOdiQcFY7ezFBmF2Ed2VbhZ3Kn00Ms9-f88nxH1UoMaUGlFJVwqO2hovizHJ8-72hYX0YOhhTwImoeOdNrN-AWol5Xee5yBmZ1jzS7evty41aSFQqCPkvytgP20c5xHNvEaGXMaosEfQ1zIdIGX4w02cpqe7c6UexCEimyvunDj3g7dI4ezw1iv-vHz11u6JJ78m3FydcveEVa_bhCvtHH0CtDsYyC-xF6e9F0cR3rMQ/48y/QBcVfBN6TSWdF9QWdEL0eA/h0/h001.NNjpRee1cLlm3AlNlNlyE7e_Klvu7DtS8pc7Uy7VF5M)** [](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9o4Obergy599CNuba8XJb1zpBYdM8H1tv23qXGyGIETuKV88t2kfT5JyOzMapzoihXc5mG8aV_M63zBxOKIX5oAkaYTWz34S3mDtaUGQw1_HGha62bC-ipvVzbxL-Wek942VSJd9ZAkcv-WzH0RZTcDfK78Lv6teJxJxTuogdi6AmbjgCHVJNFmCkEzaBI9WVW3HVE8zVb-3PAZ2zvF-uw2Q1MarXS7E0jje1-N5ahcAiSpmhYECAUoQyDRym9pe3fz9pExjv01gr6lgpjtsAY257gDKR-ha95U8LavAkQFD7tpGz22ipkRcqCqonvx72A0MQiGOOe4AVHqkNSAIXTrSUV0bmXXCFrpO9c3dQPDM/48y/QBcVfBN6TSWdF9QWdEL0eA/h1/h001.xqDksFLbpCRcbXrjoz7B1u1RkkCoopPru98ONMLyisE) Since then, we announced a plan to knock on 5 million doors to elect Kamala Harris along with with CPD Action and People's Action — two WFP national member organizations — and we're already up and running in Philly! We are living in uncertain times. But we do know this: we cannot let Donald Trump and MAGA extremists return to power. Electing Kamala Harris as President is one step — one important step — toward our goal of winning power for working people and building a government responsive to all of us, not just the wealthy few. But it’s going to take a huge team effort to build the biggest possible movement to defeat Donald Trump in November. **[Can you please split a donation between Kamala Harris and the Working Families Party’s general election fund today to help kickstart our efforts to turn out voters in races up and down the ballot this fall?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9o4Obergy599CNuba8XJb1zpBYdM8H1tv23qXGyGIETuKV88t2kfT5JyOzMapzoihkBR9grU1Ol42hfXp0Pm_rEYHioRRnBPtYmkonsFmcc_UNnQq6NHhuYSxS7cL2ufIt1B7reaBHLm24BM9eDD_2VFA-aFLJig2mcZKm8w5Gsot57xePBeoReVslPlsXbwxeWqybrKtmRzoMVCuNvvLX36b3W7dnAE35gAjsan1hXgvLy8O96g2kJ8o4PnmwRb8_W9TwYuUuhbCqti3U9vbQVJUGFWzxRCQHjev6uNnvoqsUURQHrUo2axxBUr7KtM_W2EMHdjWgD-mStbsotBwHIG-fX83XuNOaEXCvhIUKwU/48y/QBcVfBN6TSWdF9QWdEL0eA/h2/h001.Fux6RszlDQy03HZhpG06hAiRCNFYFn6TAFXoqzpx3Qs)**
* * *
**_UPDATE ON CONGRESSIONAL ELECTIONS_** Over the last month, four of our progressive champions had their primary elections for Congress. **Rep. Ilhan Omar** decisively won her primary for Minnesota's 5th Congressional District. Since her election in 2018, Ilhan has delivered millions for her community, led the fight for affordable housing, and been an urgent voice in Congress in calling for a stop to the flow of bombs to the Israeli government. In Michigan, **Rep. Rashida Tlaib** remained uncontested in her primary election, despite a donor involved with AIPAC offering a candidate in another race _$20 million_ if he ran against her instead. Rashida has shown time and time again that she will fight for the people, and we are grateful to have her continue representing Michigan in Congress — unbought and unbossed. **The primary for Arizona’s 3rd Congressional District remains too close to call, and is headed to a mandatory recount.** WFP champion Raquel Terán remains just 42 votes down against an opponent supported by MAGA donors and a crypto-currency PAC. The next step is a robust legal effort to ensure that every single vote is counted, especially from marginalized young and Latino voters who are more likely to have their votes thrown out. **[Can you pitch in to Raquel Terán’s legal fund to ensure they have the resources for a successful recount?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9q15MBOuxLQzJAZI1mzxIBjqqGOVyETkv-kMpN2BbE81p57TVAzgJrumZiVkwaZiW4e5Nn_wLmI4n3gIXIoz2mkf3dvtREGUSgetUYwQ3pbtKm4fL3-aUJ9yKxpEWVRYOj1dQpQA55dOwl9WdiSGVJig8LKw3sWyc-NcoMzXS4OVRz8euDjp8sOwBF6AEMDJauX2xfJ2ZHgGuV1sHceRPwacgpUa4dQ4NKBGiH0bEKcjuWc0k2WtCDY9kuzOuS6sBUS_9PC3R-orSKAfvG-T7Og12Ln72oi8iBIbd1CuHtiQWm_f3blhBxmWYV7FuZ_QoKHz53NQHjk3a310cZr4DuAJyzFBmgn4Uuad3GRB2qPM/48y/QBcVfBN6TSWdF9QWdEL0eA/h3/h001.wWgEex3QmYkdFgk0yGpktXMDOgzXZZZ-njsvaIEUwKs)** Unfortunately, **Rep. Cori Bush** lost her re-election campaign following $12 million in outside spending from billionaire-backed Super PACs to defeat her. Four years ago, Cori took down a 52-year political dynasty, and in her time in Congress she has been a bold leader standing up for working people. From sleeping on the Capitol steps to extend a federal eviction moratorium, to sponsoring the Ceasefire Now resolution, her voice has made a real impact on our country. We thank her for her years standing up for working families in and out of Congress.
* * *
**_NEW YORKER FEATURE ON WFP’S NICOLAS O’ROURKE_** _The New Yorker_ published a piece on Philadelphia Working Families Party City Councilmember Nicolas O’Rourke and his work organizing Black men and communities for Kamala Harris during this critical election year. [](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMdIKnkz6vqcrJ2SRX3oIhBxlpO5L707iNJc5ruvjk7o7O3snYO9zcFtVhPsm4aQABRpOpSZnGM8n0YD8g_sMmKKi17hUhBeAoHTQq6xBPlsBMU6PwI_1KbNDl1RV00Yi1nHl8ro22rHcg4zmP-NYgj5KLnEX_BSrhAEwQs_oMXUjrA9TzqraJsuVe95Jr-MHVExobBCYYNWpQhZ6RYrr8nZSMKustKIo7mHIo3s079FU2DeyDfu_SeIgppB3SwABCQc9EAjwvMb8KKAz0xftJrmsEOsIhxhxhF9KL3TIv3uuPO445Q0X5ccBeNbGtZln0n4OHo17UUMrgkjGybB32vq8QqgKDEv9Q7JaefhAaYWZ/48y/QBcVfBN6TSWdF9QWdEL0eA/h4/h001.8VpNm2mAfKRWqY9USajasZlHV6YS9SjQXtRtYq-DLSs) **[Read the article here.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMdIKnkz6vqcrJ2SRX3oIhBxlpO5L707iNJc5ruvjk7o7O3snYO9zcFtVhPsm4aQABRpOpSZnGM8n0YD8g_sMmKKi17hUhBeAoHTQq6xBPlsB0SQSDCvDZqffXPUVPS6ooMUu2KY2ZcNTJFt_YVs1jk85KgwwLtTqmgJrOxtdaaRXmOMRf3keUNv5PKrL5EV69Ne_28hD4ADoOo1nhksTVbihZl-Y75aWpXqV6DCrCnqvv_a_FVaacTV36EFNhIWIN9yc4ArEX4iL5Kt156lQFVGQL3gXgUYBDBdVQQHPjtqyk_KQ-19V5OZDjVPBeMbQSJqIllkpukdgDVVWOljwtAAI4Tb_cKvIsLCrsgskUEvD/48y/QBcVfBN6TSWdF9QWdEL0eA/h5/h001.SmwWa2lgKnWVx7mB9-54vAZUSOgkbclRE2rs_hTAAhs)**
* * *
**_PROGRESSIVES FOR HARRIS_** The WFP and our National Director Maurice Mitchell joined the Progressives for Harris organizing call with Senator Bernie Sanders, Senator Elizabeth Warren, UAW President Shawn Fain, and other progressive leaders and activists. On the call, we talked with over 150,000 viewers about what’s at stake in November, how a Harris presidency can help us achieve our long-term goals, and the steps we can take to win this monumental election. **[Watch a recording of the Progressives for Harris call here.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWolD3zHhXqbTzTKtlkMpKIZxZ2gPYI_uzJvt9RRTw8X357ypztaUURc2lfstfi30N-HD50xm4jXDsp1XKUG6-jZbILNGeOHRI2dB6l53_x9LGJI70SyQTwemfRr9gte-9YZkA_jXow_dIONZ_eGOkUHib0Ll92krhxnACClFjUHZh7G3SfoZ0DJMdPbeHN35JFDCrZ-orU3D2nitmM8B78sTqini3hur0uYQe1FTwsEotFKjksp6iE4dw-MdvpRH-22SYcnLbfuYh3F1PMkv58/48y/QBcVfBN6TSWdF9QWdEL0eA/h6/h001.wB5T5xr68Gwk4zkIpGaAYGx84dyCb1FF7B_MItu0weM)**
* * *
**_WISCONSIN ELECTION WINS_** The Wisconsin Working Families Party saw some major wins in their primary elections last Tuesday, including voting down two Republican-authored ballot measures that would have prevented the state government from helping people in need during natural disasters and other crises. Three local champions also won their primaries, including State Rep. Ryan Clancy, an outspoken advocate for social and economic justice across the state. We're so proud of our team, and our sibling organization Working Families Power, for knocking over 60,000 doors and sending nearly 90,000 texts to reach voters in these key elections. As we head into this November's election, we're going to keep up the fight and help elect a government that works for the many, not the few.
* * *
**_ORGANIZING AROUND REAL HOUSEWIVES_**
_The Hollywood Reporter_ covered the WFP’s cultural organizing around the Real Housewives franchise, engaging existing fans and meeting them where they’re at. WFP Director of Strategy Nelini Stamp told _The Hollywood Reporter:_ “I don’t watch Bravo for people to be political. But politics is not just about the two-party system. Politics is also what you live up against... These are women at the end of the day and women’s rights specifically now are being attacked.” **[Read the full article.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMb6a2f0AoxsuOoNLjquQL3T_BJPe67bQn0N1KgIxA-DB0XA5z6Qty1kCWU74C5g3psOZTzo_jh45j3u18UImG8NiswXF4XukVh9ujuK8DFt05E3bylnoq5VkPQCj4Sj_arUscZhh-Qo1wHp4mxzAvp2TdMA62r7GzBpPIGdEtYWaNYIDf-R7fvV_HuRu4uLXEv6i_Zhh8RvUXOUbiu3EVu8RU2ktZ_QVt3XApn-zGlDUfNL1bLNjWZqwK-kFFBU6aX701e59Vwhdu9sGPuIkr2_jJSS5dfwQsJm-4vSOA7GsnLd8IgVy7vaGooVjDqhSnRSBVz9Y-_yPU1ixIPDOa0_fa5Dm7djNcDyA4sqyvo9X/48y/QBcVfBN6TSWdF9QWdEL0eA/h7/h001.xiH42p97HorehnhNW7XsfgjBO5kPJ8j1c0DWJzdFx6I)**
* * *

clean_body: | | | Peter, We’ve got a lot to catch up on since our last WFP newsletter. Read on for more information on our work around the presidential election, key congressional races, and more — as well as how you can get involved this month! WFP ENDORSES KAMALA HARRIS FOR PRESIDENT Last month, Working Families Party members, chapters, and party leaders voted overwhelmingly to endorse Kamala Harris for President of the United States, with 95% of the total vote in support. Since then, we announced a plan to knock on 5 million doors to elect Kamala Harris along with with CPD Action and People's Action — two WFP national member organizations — and we're already up and running in Philly! We are living in uncertain times. But we do know this: we cannot let Donald Trump and MAGA extremists return to power. Electing Kamala Harris as President is one step — one important step — toward our goal of winning power for working people and building a government responsive to all of us, not just the wealthy few. But it’s going to take a huge team effort to build the biggest possible movement to defeat Donald Trump in November. UPDATE ON CONGRESSIONAL ELECTIONS Over the last month, four of our progressive champions had their primary elections for Congress. Rep. Ilhan Omar decisively won her primary for Minnesota's 5th Congressional District. Since her election in 2018, Ilhan has delivered millions for her community, led the fight for affordable housing, and been an urgent voice in Congress in calling for a stop to the flow of bombs to the Israeli government. In Michigan, Rep. Rashida Tlaib remained uncontested in her primary election, despite a donor involved with AIPAC offering a candidate in another race $20 million if he ran against her instead. Rashida has shown time and time again that she will fight for the people, and we are grateful to have her continue representing Michigan in Congress — unbought and unbossed. The primary for Arizona’s 3rd Congressional District remains too close to call, and is headed to a mandatory recount. WFP champion Raquel Terán remains just 42 votes down against an opponent supported by MAGA donors and a crypto-currency PAC. The next step is a robust legal effort to ensure that every single vote is counted, especially from marginalized young and Latino voters who are more likely to have their votes thrown out. Unfortunately, Rep. Cori Bush lost her re-election campaign following $12 million in outside spending from billionaire-backed Super PACs to defeat her. Four years ago, Cori took down a 52-year political dynasty, and in her time in Congress she has been a bold leader standing up for working people. From sleeping on the Capitol steps to extend a federal eviction moratorium, to sponsoring the Ceasefire Now resolution, her voice has made a real impact on our country. We thank her for her years standing up for working families in and out of Congress. NEW YORKER FEATURE ON WFP’S NICOLAS O’ROURKE The New Yorker published a piece on Philadelphia Working Families Party City Councilmember Nicolas O’Rourke and his work organizing Black men and communities for Kamala Harris during this critical election year. PROGRESSIVES FOR HARRIS The WFP and our National Director Maurice Mitchell joined the Progressives for Harris organizing call with Senator Bernie Sanders, Senator Elizabeth Warren, UAW President Shawn Fain, and other progressive leaders and activists. On the call, we talked with over 150,000 viewers about what’s at stake in November, how a Harris presidency can help us achieve our long-term goals, and the steps we can take to win this monumental election. WISCONSIN ELECTION WINS The Wisconsin Working Families Party saw some major wins in their primary elections last Tuesday, including voting down two Republican-authored ballot measures that would have prevented the state government from helping people in need during natural disasters and other crises. Three local champions also won their primaries, including State Rep. Ryan Clancy, an outspoken advocate for social and economic justice across the state. We're so proud of our team, and our sibling organization Working Families Power, for knocking over 60,000 doors and sending nearly 90,000 texts to reach voters in these key elections. As we head into this November's election, we're going to keep up the fight and help elect a government that works for the many, not the few. ORGANIZING AROUND REAL HOUSEWIVES The Hollywood Reporter covered the WFP’s cultural organizing around the Real Housewives franchise, engaging existing fans and meeting them where they’re at. WFP Director of Strategy Nelini Stamp told The Hollywood Reporter: “I don’t watch Bravo for people to be political. But politics is not just about the two-party system. Politics is also what you live up against... These are women at the end of the day and women’s rights specifically now are being attacked.” WFP NATIONAL DIRECTOR MAURICE MITCHELL GIVES KEYNOTE ADDRESS National Director Maurice Mitchell gave a keynote address at the progressive conference Netroots Nation, explaining our goals and vision. “This is the future: A multi-party democracy, political coalitions, independent political power. This isn't just about blocking the right, it's about building a better, more democratic, more resilient, multi-racial, feminist, and responsive politics. That's our goal at the Working Families party.” UPCOMING EVENTS: On Wednesday, September 18 at 8 PM ET/5 PM PT, join our sixth Making Meaning of the Moment mass call, where WFP National Director Maurice Mitchell and special guests will be talking about recent updates in American politics, as well as the concrete actions we can take to block the far-right and build working class power. Join us on Tuesday, September 3 at 6 PM ET/3 PM PT for our next Text Party! We’ll be reaching voters about this November's general election and make sure their voices are heard come Election Day. Training will be provided at the start of the call. The next WFP Welcome Gathering is on Thursday, August 22 at 7 PM ET/4 PM PT. Whether this is your first welcome gathering or you come every month, we invite you to join us to hear from WFP staff, members, and activists about our vision for a country that works for the many, not the few. Thanks for reading our WFP newsletter, Peter! We know that was a lot to cover. That also means that there’s a lot of work to do. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Most Republicans still haven’t reckoned with what Donald Trump’s embrace of far-right white supremacists means for their party.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240816&t=1&akid=1067%2E587540%2EYiYRyY)
Peter,
The neo-Nazi “Unite The Right” rally that killed Heather Heyer and injured dozens of others happened seven years ago this week in Charlottesville, VA.
But despite the violence and the disgusting scenes of neo-Nazis with tiki torches marching through the street, **most Republicans _still_ haven’t reckoned with what Donald Trump’s embrace of far-right white supremacists means for their party:**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240816?refcode=em20240816&amount=5&refcode2=1067_587540_YiYRyY&akid=1067%2E587540%2EYiYRyY)
Joe Biden was right when he said the 2020 election was a battle for the soul of the nation. **Only that battle isn’t over yet** — we’re _still_ in a battle over what kind of future we’ll have as a country.
[**Will you split a $5 contribution between Leaders We Deserve and Kamala Harris’s campaign today to help us win the battle for the soul of our nation?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240816?refcode=em20240816&amount=5&refcode2=1067_587540_YiYRyY&akid=1067%2E587540%2EYiYRyY)
**But despite what we saw in Charlottesville, I truly couldn’t be more optimistic right now.** President Biden’s decision to pass the torch to a new generation and endorse Kamala Harris — AND her selection of Tim Walz as her running mate — has re-energized voters like no one thought possible just one month ago.
Trump's lead is slipping in the polls, and massive crowds are filling stadiums across the country to hear VP Harris and Governor Walz speak.
**Again, despite what we saw in Charlottesville, it’s clear to me that America is still fundamentally a nation that rejects hatred, bigotry, and wannabe dictators like Trump.**
Now it’s our job to carry that spirit forward and keep the momentum going through Election Day and beyond. Because it doesn’t matter how many more stadiums we fill up or how many more polls Kamala leads in — the only poll that matters is the one that happens on November 5th.
Leaders We Deserve is working around the clock to elect young leaders all over the country who reflect the best of America, and who loudly and clearly reject the kind of violence, hatred, and division we saw in Charlottesville.
But as a grassroots organization, **we don’t take any corporate donations** — we count on supporters like you to power our work.
[**So Peter, if you’re ready to win the battle for the soul of the nation, will you split a $5 contribution between Leaders We Deserve and the Harris-Walz campaign today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240816?refcode=em20240816&amount=5&refcode2=1067_587540_YiYRyY&akid=1067%2E587540%2EYiYRyY)

Thank you,
David Hogg

body:
Gov. Polis calls 74th Legislature into special session to address property tax
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s5o8c888e5e)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s1k63a841ea)**
| | Hi everyone,
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, August 16, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Gov. Polis calls 74th Legislature into special session to address property tax](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s1k6cffc0ed)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s1q36708ffc)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s9qabb6c6ac)
A deal has been reached to remove two qualified property tax initiatives from the fall ballot in exchange for a special session of the 74th Colorado Legislature to address property tax.
Gov. Jared Polis called the special session in an executive order Thursday morning. The single-item call on property tax will convene at 10 a.m. Monday, Aug. 26, his order reads.
In order for a special session of the legislature to be called, it must be deemed to be an emergency, or as his order calls it, an “extraordinary occasion”. The special session may only include those items in the call, in this case specifically property tax.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s9h052876c3)**
|
---
**[‘It’s crucial that we work together’: House Republican leaders call for bipartisan cooperation in special session](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/sfi63816a7c)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s9h2a6d9239)
* The House Republicans, who are in the minority with only 19 out of 65 seats, have expressed frustration over their limited influence and the majority party's handling of property tax issues, citing past failures to collaborate.
* The special session aims to preempt citizen-led initiatives on property taxes from reaching the ballot, highlighting the urgency and high stakes of finding a legislative solution.
* Minority Leader Rose Pugliese stressed the importance of the session in providing effective property tax relief while ensuring local governments can maintain essential services.
* Governor Polis has stated he will not sign any legislation from this session until the proponents of Prop. 108 and Initiative 50 withdraw these measures from the ballot, aiming to manage the session's outcomes strategically.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/sap183252e3)**
|
---
**[As Aurora police monitor potential protest Saturday, questions persist as to Venezuelan gang’s infiltration of city](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/sbp840c6202)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/saub9d31dc7)
* Aurora police are on alert for potential protests related to the Venezuelan presidential election, following a large, lawless gathering on election night and ongoing concerns about gang activity.
* Recent disturbances have been linked to the Venezuelan prison gang Tren de Aragua, accused of escalating crime and controlling multiple properties in Aurora.
* Former ICE director and U.S. Representative candidate John Fabbricatore and Council Member Danielle Jurinsky have publicly discussed the city's handling of these issues, suggesting mismanagement and lack of transparency.
* Police are preparing for possible large gatherings this Saturday, although there is no confirmed protest planned. The situation continues to unfold with local officials and police maintaining vigilance over gang activities and public safety in the area.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s1i9b87d868)**
|
---
**[Colorado Capitol rolls back ban on political-themed apparel after kicking out KNUS host for pro-life sweatshirt](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/sfm9ebd3ced)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s4i73970496)
* The Colorado State Capitol has revoked its policy that banned politically themed apparel in the House and Senate galleries after a local radio host faced ejection for wearing a "Pro-Life U" pullover.
* The Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression intervened, threatening a First Amendment lawsuit, which led to the policy's rescission.
* Jeff Hunt, the radio host affected by the previous policy, expressed satisfaction with the outcome, highlighting the importance of allowing political expression at the state Capitol.
* The foundation's legal action cited the policy as an overbroad and arbitrary enforcement of rules that stifled free speech, particularly in a political setting.
* The ban's removal was confirmed by state officials and has since been removed from the Capitol website and gallery signs, ensuring that visitors can wear political statements without restriction.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/sdi6bea6400)**
|
---
**[As school opens, in many districts there are too few teachers, drivers and declining enrollments](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/sav742ff4c6)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s0mde49a7a0)
* Colorado school districts, including Jefferson County and Boulder Valley, are starting the school year with significant staff shortages in teaching and transportation roles.
* Boulder Valley is addressing these shortages by offering signing bonuses for bus drivers and implementing new academic programs to attract more students. Jefferson County resolved its bus driver shortage by using smaller buses that don't require commercial licenses, ensuring full staffing for the current year.
* Widespread issues such as non-competitive pay, safety concerns, and the limitations of standardized teaching are driving licensed educators out of the profession in Colorado.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s3jdba74f4a)**
|
---
**[Denver schools voters will be asked to decide whether to approve nearly $1 billion bond](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/sagca720372)** [KDVR](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/sfo66eef201)
* The Denver Public Schools board has unanimously agreed to present a $975 million bond measure to voters this fall, aimed at upgrading facilities across the district.
* If passed, nearly a third of the funds will be allocated for maintenance of 154 schools, focusing on crucial updates like electrical and plumbing renovations in buildings that average 55 years old.
* The bond will also allocate substantial funds for installing air conditioning in 29 schools that currently lack it, with additional investments planned for arts, athletics, new building construction, and enhancements in safety and technology.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s1ka2ea60bf)
|
---
**[Bidenomics or Kamalanomics? Either way it’s the worst inflation record since Reagan sacked Carter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s7if8e95c13)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s9gc44f7976)
* U.S. inflation has risen 20.2% under the Biden-Harris administration, the highest since President Jimmy Carter. Vice President Harris has cast decisive votes for major spending bills like the $1.9 trillion American Rescue Plan, which many economists blame for fueling inflation.
* A majority of voters believe their financial situation has worsened under Biden’s economic policies, according to a recent poll. President Biden suggests the lack of popularity for his economic policies is due to Republican opposition and poor communication of his administration’s achievements.
* Former President Jimmy Carter plans to vote for Harris in her presidential run against Donald Trump, adding a historical perspective to the current economic debate.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s4if682eda8)
|
---
**[Devotional: Embracing responsibility is a legacy to remember](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s0md6e2c11f)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/sajde9eabce)
_A soul without a well-established aim (purpose) loses itself. That’s who I was when I first met Richard G. Madsen more than 38 years ago._
_Richard, my father-in-law, passed away on July 6, 2024. It’s challenging to capture the essence of Richard in a single word –- loving, caring, loyal and so much more come to mind. Yet, if I had to choose just one word, it would undeniably be “RESPONSIBLE!”_
_He embodied responsibility in a way that transformed my life, guiding me from a sense of aimlessness to a place of purpose, allowing me to relish life alongside his remarkable daughter, Sherrie._
_Witnessing Richard’s life provides a living example of responsibility and its practical application in everyday life. His exemplary conduct served as a guide for meeting not only specific obligations, but also making conscientious choices in various aspects of life._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/saufdddcb23)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Following anti-gun session, bipartisan 2nd Amendment Caucus is being formed by Reps. Armagost, Bottoms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s4o59a21d5a)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | AUGUST 14** _If state Reps. Ryan Armagost and Scott Bottoms are successful, their newly-formed House caucus will have bipartisan membership and strive to support, promote and protect gun rights for all Coloradans._
**[‘We’re going to get this seat back’: Bright vying to reclaim Senate District 13 for Republicans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s9gb238d703)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | AUGUST 12** _Scott Bright has an eye on reclaiming the Senate District 13 seat for Republicans in the Colorado Legislature._
**_[Devotional: Embracing red, white and true authenticity beyond politics](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._Mtg/s0v39c45896)_** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | STATE | AUGUST 11** _As a pastor, I often face pressure to align with a political party. People want to know if I lean toward the red or blue party. My response is simple but meaningful: “I don’t align with red or blue, only with what is true!”_

Former President Jimmy Carter plans to vote for Harris in her presidential run against Donald Trump, adding a historical perspective to the current economic debate. | A soul without a well-established aim (purpose) loses itself. That’s who I was when I first met Richard G. Madsen more than 38 years ago. Richard, my father-in-law, passed away on July 6, 2024. It’s challenging to capture the essence of Richard in a single word –- loving, caring, loyal and so much more come to mind. Yet, if I had to choose just one word, it would undeniably be “RESPONSIBLE!” He embodied responsibility in a way that transformed my life, guiding me from a sense of aimlessness to a place of purpose, allowing me to relish life alongside his remarkable daughter, Sherrie. Witnessing Richard’s life provides a living example of responsibility and its practical application in everyday life. His exemplary conduct served as a guide for meeting not only specific obligations, but also making conscientious choices in various aspects of life. | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | AUGUST 14 If state Reps. The fight for equal rights has been central to my work in the Maryland Senate. I’m committed to breaking down barriers that prevent our communities from fully participating in our democracy, _and this will be at the heart of my work in Congress._

Fear and discrimination are tools used all too often to divide – particularly where decisions are made and at the ballot box. It matters when testifying for legislation to expand critical health services for LGBTQ+ neighbors at the State House, it matters when ensuring books that reflect our community and our history are available at our libraries, and participation matters when we elect people to represent and fight for our values.

We can be the generation that guarantees equal rights for all Americans, regardless of their gender identity or sexual orientation, and I look forward to continuing my work starting day one as we fight to make that a reality.

Dear Peter,
During my announcement speech more than a year ago, I said that I have so many skeletons in the closet that if they could vote, I would be king of the world. I knew much would be made of my past. I have been around politics. I know of its hazards.
I also knew that my vision and policies would inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you _declare yourself foe to widespread corporate-government corruption and declare yourself opposed to a runaway war machine_ (a war machine killing innocents and draining our country’s coffers), you will inspire resistance in the establishment. Put another way, many powerful people want to make sure the gravy train never stops. And I derail gravy trains.
When you point out the morbidity of our two-party system -- a system that our first president warned us about, a system that is now largely predicated on hating fellow humans -- **you will inspire resistance in the establishment.**
When you’ve spent much of your life successfully fighting against our biggest corporations and worst polluters; fighting against mining, timber, hydroelectricity, and oil industries on behalf of the voiceless and the indigenous; fighting against agribusiness barons blithely ravaging the lives of small farmers and small towns, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you remind Americans that censorship and other curtailments of our civil liberties always arrive burnished with a moral and patriotic gloss, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you invoke our crisis of meaning, our deaths of despair, the addiction, and the many children lost to screens, ill health, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you are wary of reductive partisan ideology and group-think; and when you refuse the common coin of today’s public discourse -- a glib second-rate cruelty delivered via the screen -- you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you assert that to better our country we must work toward a politics that heals this divide and affirms our mutual belonging, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
