As you perhaps know, I am used to such resistance -- used to the bile and malign distortions that accompany speaking out on high-stakes issues. And I know that the establishment’s treatment of me -- while challenging -- makes perfect sense.
The dark and elaborately refined arts of partisan politics deployed to end my campaign (the documented censorship and shadowbanning; the out-in-the-open, anti-democratic, and well-funded attempts to keep me off ballots through expensive, complex, time-consuming legal challenges; the thwarting of debate access; the withholding of secret service protection; the paid staged protests; the sundry campaigns of defamation and scandalmongering) are the logical reactions of a threatened -- and very unwell -- status quo.
And underneath all of this -- underneath much of this election cycle, underneath much of this moment in our nation’s politics -- is a sort of destitution. A destitution of heart. It’s no small wonder so many people have withdrawn from civic life and democracy altogether.
**A broken bond needs to be reestablished in our country. We need more soul-searching and less partisan warfare.**
Our work as Americans, whether we like it or not, transcends all labels and all parties. It seems we will recognize this reality and act accordingly; or be broken into it. History is not made occasionally on great stages by the privileged few but made daily in the depths of each human soul. Ours is a beautiful nation, still.
According to the Internet, our country (and our world) is in chaos. But in post offices, parks, and grocery stores our beauty still heartens and shines. We all see it every day. It is in the name of that beauty that I work.
It is in the name of that beauty that I run to be your next president.
**The true power of America is not its comfort, wealth, or military might, but its ideals of liberty, democracy, and generosity.**
This campaign is about honoring and restoring those ideals -- regardless of the defamation, evasion, and trickery. We knew those were coming.

| I’ll cut right to the chase, we have got to win this race. There is so much at stake in this election. Republicans like Beth Van Duyne are pushing a national abortion ban and restricting contraception. While times are tough for many Texas families, Van Duyne cares more about scoring political points than serving her district.

We’ve seen what four years of Van Duyne in Congress has got us...not a damn thing.

| Republican Headquarters Grand Opening in Washington County!

Join us for donuts & coffee, yard signs & bumper stickers, and a whole bunch of people who care about our country!

**Tomorrow, Saturday, August 17, at 118 E Oak Ridge Dr., Suite 1800, Hagerstown, 9AM! **

Neil will be there to talk with everyone before he goes out door knocking. Please wear your green shirts! (Let us know if you need one!)

If you want to make a difference and help our country, now is the time. You can help by putting out Neil’s yard sign and putting bumper stickers on the back window of your car! It takes 7 times before people remember a name, and your yard sign and bumper stickers can help Neil to bring common-sense back to DC!

Come for the opening at 9AM, then make new friends afterwards while doing office work. If you like to talk with people, consider wearing sneakers and joining Neil and a door knocking team for the morning!

body:
I’m officially running to defeat Sen. Rick Scott.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240816?refcode=em20240816&refcode2=9286_434096_K3Iu8Y&akid=9286%2E434096%2EK3Iu8Y)
Derek,
**My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. And I’m officially running to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.**
Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.
But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — _and win_ — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.
**I've set an ambitious goal to raise $25,000 by midnight to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it.** **[Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and John Fetterman right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240816?refcode=em20240816-9286&refcode2=9286_434096_K3Iu8Y&akid=9286%2E434096%2EK3Iu8Y)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240816?amount=5&refcode=em20240816-9286&refcode2=9286_434096_K3Iu8Y&akid=9286%2E434096%2EK3Iu8Y)**
**When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America.** We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.
Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.
**My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America.** **But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.**
Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a _billion_ dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide ban on abortions. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare benefits that so many rely on.
**That’s why I’m running to defeat him this November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, Derek,_we can take him down._**
**So please, I’m personally asking:** **[Will you become a grassroots donor by splitting a gift between my campaign and John Fetterman today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick Scott and defending our Senate majority.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240816?refcode=em20240816-9286&refcode2=9286_434096_K3Iu8Y&akid=9286%2E434096%2EK3Iu8Y)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240816?amount=5&refcode=em20240816-9286&refcode2=9286_434096_K3Iu8Y&akid=9286%2E434096%2EK3Iu8Y)**
Thank you for joining me in this fight for a better Florida and a better future for all of us.
With gratitude,
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20240816-9286-footer&t=1&refcode2=9286_434096_K3Iu8Y&akid=9286%2E434096%2EK3Iu8Y)**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. I’ll be honest with you: I was never “supposed” to be a member of Congress.

When I ran in 2022 to succeed my friend, the late Congressman Don Young, I was one of 48 candidates for the open Congressional seat. 48! But I defied the odds and advanced to the runoff.

But this time is different. Here’s why: The far-right has had over two years to strategize and come up with a plan to defeat me. They’ve been making early investments in attack ads. I’ll be honest with you: I was never “supposed” to be a member of Congress. When I ran in 2022 to succeed my friend, the late Congressman Don Young, I was one of 48 candidates for the open Congressional seat. 48! But I defied the odds and advanced to the runoff. Political “experts” said I had no real chance at winning. In fact, here were the predictions: = | = I was counted out by pundits in the lower 48, but here’s why that didn’t matter: Because every day, Alaskans from every region of the state refused to count me out and gave me a chance to be heard. I went on to win the special election and make history as the first Alaska Native to ever serve in Congress. And flash forward to now, I’m running for reelection and putting in the work each day so I can win once again in November. But this time is different. The NRCC and Mike Johnson’s super PAC are investing $7 million in attack ads alone to unseat me. And that’s just the tip of the iceberg, Peter. My team and I are putting in the work to reach Alaskans regardless of where they live and regardless of how they can be reached to share my accomplishments and my vision for our future. But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

### Be the first to see this shocking documentary collection, exposing corruption and manipulation in U.S. politics and calling all American voters to action!
In an era marked by deep divisions and escalating rhetoric, as we prepare to see the votes of True the Vote has sponsored the release of an explosive documentary collection, _We Will Not Be Silenced,_ to shed light on a troubling pattern in American politics that many would prefer to keep quiet. This 41-minute film, together with additional video testimonials, chronicles the controversial tactics employed during the 2008 Democrat primaries—tactics that ultimately led to Barack Obama's nomination over Hillary Clinton.
Produced by Bettina Sofia Viviano, _We Will Not Be Silenced_ is not a partisan attack, but a stark recounting of events from those who were there—Democrats who participated in the primaries and witnessed firsthand the corruption and rule-breaking. The film offers an unfiltered look at the inner workings of the Democrat Party during a pivotal moment in its history, revealing how the powerful Chicago political machine, with Obama as its figurehead, manipulated the process to secure his victory.
What makes _We Will Not Be Silenced_ particularly compelling is the credibility of its narrators. The individuals featured in the documentary are not disgruntled outsiders; they are lifelong Democrats who believed in the system and were shocked to see it fail them. Their accounts reveal a landscape of voter intimidation, fraudulent caucus results, and a blatant disregard for the party's own rules—actions that led many to believe that Obama's victory was orchestrated rather than earned.
This documentary, however, is more than just a historical expose. It serves as a crucial warning about the fragility of democratic processes, particularly within the Democrat Party. The tactics exposed in the 2008 primaries didn't vanish with Obama's election; instead, they set a precedent that has only grown worse with each election cycle

Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=ca36658008cd4a0ebab118d1341690bf&_e=a-wIzbUT-JAqEReBku8c6xKehxDIYrw7YJAr_tLGq1WjQN83nUlJpUq0mKerMd4GINNITQ2ddAx0Ty4FYLhYt8aKsSfkYrLs180ryz-thL4nBA7EQJTzAgw_5mXLIpFOnbvQg3auSI29LZsp8gE_KvcSTDcQWJew34Y54TvJqEig_fbwr6RwBND9_QrTOnefjH7Do-0k-5e3AefLqJHTzG0oh0R0NRmRKojdZDVuyngb6xmqVJowKB6A99j0gw9ccnjBhCspTSztIDd1_xGvilQ7gTCN1lvKTqgheOuj4Ziy2Z-Y-GhNkl0hoBq_jH5CoLVKWcUVso-b7JabtLLyoq-qwxBjdVb22u7v6Y3aLw46GfYtEdHj8Emen5yDdQO9lij9UP-Bp1a2b4xMemuCzlA5Ya9zSriwZwNqYKE6UzSgNbja0XTMkbPBy3bHqpcEk6PqWy6tNiKqItJofom96zPBnPIn-mKiQPYVD2vQAX081Uae1iAT-LyeWanxwUg8)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
